title: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
description:
**Job Description**
We are the team building tools and integration for Cost Management services to monitor cloud spending, increase accountability, and optimize cloud efficiency under Oracle cloud infrastructure (OCI). We use latest open source and modern web technologies, all running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to provide the best Cloud customer experience possible.
  
  
We value bottoms up, member driven agile teams; we focus on working software that helps our customers succeed; we encourage risk taking and innovation time to inspire leaps in design and productivity; above all else, we value productivity, autonomy, and fulfilment of our team members so that they can achieve their full potential, and beyond.
  
  
Join us and thrive!
  
  
What our team needs:
  
  
We are looking for an ambitious, talented, energetic, and self-motivated Software Developer in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Our team is a driven development organisation, developing the applications that support all Subscription Billing and Customer engagement to the Cloud.
  
  
In this role, you will be immersed in and exposed to complex systems and their integration as Oracle cloud subscription data travels to multiple systems from its inception. Your role is to enable internal and external customers to manage their cloud cost.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  

* 2+ year of experience in delivering and operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
* Strong knowledge of modern object-oriented languages (Java), PL/SQL, RDBMS databases, NoSQL systems, storage, and distributed persistence technologies.
* Proven background in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Must have strong analytical, written and communications skills.
* Experience using open source technologies such as Docker & Kubernetes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information in a clear, concise manner to all audiences
* Nice to have: Python 3, Bigdata processing with Apache Spark, data pipelines experience

**Responsibilities**
As a member of the software engineering division, you will apply basic to intermediate knowledge of software architecture to perform software development tasks associated with developing, debugging or designing software applications or operating systems according to provided design specifications. Build enhancements within an existing software architecture and occasionally suggest improvements to the architecture.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Design, development and enhancement of new and existing products and services from inception and design through deployment.
* Adopt the OCI standard tools and DevOps standards, and practices.
* Build CI/CD environments and streamline deployments for variety of applications in cloud.
* Conduct code and architecture reviews of the products and services.
* Resolve performance and scalability issues related to products and services.
* Identify opportunities to improve health, scalability, and resiliency of products and services.
* Build highly complex enhancements and resolve complex bugs.
* You will be building tools for monitoring complex systems and high volume transactions, and their integration with other business applications.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana, India
  
  
**This role requires working from our local Hyderabad office 2-3x a week**
.
  
  
ABC Fitness is building an intelligent platform for the fitness industry, with AI embedded into the products, workflows, and decision points our customers rely on every day. The AI Platform team builds the foundational capabilities that enable engineering and product teams to safely and reliably develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered experiences.
  
  
This includes the LLM gateway, developer tooling, coding agents, inline guardrails, evaluation frameworks, retrieval capabilities, and the platform services that support production AI use cases. Our customers are the engineers building these systems and the product teams delivering AI features to users.
  
  
As an AI Platform Engineer, you will own platform deliverables end to end. You’ll design, build, launch, instrument, and operate capabilities against clearly defined SLOs. You’ll make adoption easy through clean interfaces, thoughtful migration paths, and documentation that enables teams to use the platform independently.
  
  
You’ll also help establish a clear architectural boundary: mechanism belongs in the request path, while policy sits outside it. The gateway executes routing and other policies but does not define them. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who combines strong platform engineering fundamentals with practical experience building and operating reliable AI systems.
  
  
This is not a model-training or research role. We value demonstrated evidence of ownership and impact over a specific number of years or a previous job title containing “AI.”
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own an AI platform deliverable from problem definition through production launch, adoption, and ongoing operation.
* Design, build, and operate platform capabilities such as LLM gateways, retrieval systems, agents, developer tooling, evaluation frameworks, and inline guardrails.
* Define success criteria and measurable outcomes before building, then use production data and baseline metrics to guide future improvements.
* Design systems with clear SLOs, strong observability, predictable failure handling, and reliable operational processes.
* Develop and maintain clean interfaces, migration paths, documentation, and paved paths that make platform adoption simple for engineering teams.
* Build retrieval and agent systems with a clear separation between retrieval quality and answer quality, supported by meaningful evaluation strategies.
* Design for secure and controlled AI execution, including least-privilege access, multi-tenant isolation, permissioning, auditability, and operational boundaries.
* Apply strong distributed systems principles, including consistency, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, rollout strategies, and failure-mode analysis.
* Use coding agents and other AI development tools effectively while validating their output through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.
* Carry operational ownership for the systems you build, including participation in an on-call rotation, incident response, and post-incident improvement.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, SRE, and Developer Experience teams to ensure platform capabilities are practical, scalable, and widely adopted.
* Establish and communicate reusable technical patterns, standards, and reference implementations for building production-ready AI systems.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* Demonstrated experience building or operating production retrieval systems, agent platforms, AI tooling, or other AI-enabled capabilities that real users depend on.
* Strong software engineering experience designing and operating distributed systems within an existing architecture.
* The ability to identify and clearly reason about consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure modes, multi-tenant isolation, security, and rollout risks.
* Practical understanding of AI system quality, including retrieval evaluation, answer quality, release gates, agent reliability, and cost per request.
* Experience designing systems with clear success criteria, measurable baselines, observability, and operational targets such as SLOs.
* Strong understanding of secure AI execution patterns, including least-privilege access, permissioning, auditability, and policy enforcement.
* Experience taking a platform or product capability from problem definition to production and remaining accountable for its reliability, adoption, and continued improvement.
* Ability to work effectively with coding agents and AI development tools, while independently verifying generated code and recommendations.
* A strong production mindset, including experience with incident response, on-call operations, monitoring, debugging, and post-incident learning.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts accessible to engineering and product stakeholders.
* A customer-focused mindset: you understand that a platform capability that teams do not adopt is not a successful outcome.
* A One Team orientation and a willingness to create reusable capabilities that enable other engineering teams to move faster and more safely.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE**

* Experience with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation systems, or AI developer platforms.
* Experience with FinOps, cost optimization, or usage-based measurement for AI systems.
* Experience in application security, policy enforcement, identity, access management, or secure platform design.
* Experience with search quality, ranking, experimentation, or relevance evaluation.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, AI observability, or production telemetry.
* Experience building multi-tenant infrastructure or internal developer platforms.
* Experience with developer advocacy, technical enablement, SDKs, documentation, or helping teams adopt new engineering capabilities.
* Familiarity with routing systems, API gateways, service orchestration, workflow engines, or platform control planes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You own at least one platform deliverable end to end, with clear success criteria, measurable baseline metrics, and a stated SLO.
* Engineering teams can adopt the capability through a clean interface, clear documentation, and a practical migration path without requiring ongoing support from you.
* AI platform releases are evaluated using meaningful quality, reliability, latency, adoption, and cost metrics.
* Retrieval quality, answer quality, agent behavior, and production reliability are measured separately and improved deliberately.
* Agents and AI systems operate with least-privilege access, appropriate isolation, strong observability, and clear operational controls.
* The platform remains reliable in production, with effective incident response, clear ownership, and continuous improvement after failures.
* Engineers and product teams use the platform to deliver AI-powered capabilities faster, more safely, and with greater confidence.
* Within your first 90 days, you own a platform deliverable and understand your team’s baseline metrics—not only its target outcomes.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

title: DevOps Engineer – Azure & AKS
description:
**Overview**
PepsiCo is seeking a highly motivated and skilled PepsiConnect DevOps Engineer to support and enhance our cloud-native platform capabilities. This role will be responsible for managing Azure infrastructure, source code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes (AKS) environments, and GitOps deployments using ArgoCD. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective platform operations while enabling rapid application delivery through automation and DevOps best practices.
  
  
The position will collaborate closely with development, architecture, security, and operations teams to drive infrastructure modernization, platform standardization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the PepsiConnect ecosystem. This role is critical in strengthening internal DevOps capabilities and reducing reliance on external vendors while supporting business-critical digital initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure to support PepsiConnect applications and services.
* Manage source code repositories, branching strategies, access controls, and release processes using Azure DevOps and Git-based platforms.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable secure and automated application deployments.
* Deploy, administer, and support Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement and manage GitOps deployment practices using ArgoCD to ensure reliable and auditable releases.
* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, ARM, or Bicep templates to automate infrastructure provisioning.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and availability using cloud-native monitoring and logging tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure, deployment, and platform-related issues to ensure operational stability.
* Drive cloud governance, security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and operational best practices.
* Analyze Azure resource utilization and implement cost optimization initiatives to improve cloud efficiency.
* Collaborate with development, architecture, security, and operations teams to support application delivery and platform modernization.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, deployment standards, and operational procedures.
* Support incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Promote DevOps best practices, automation, and operational excellence across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, or Platform Engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
* 2+ years of experience managing and supporting Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, branching strategies, and release management.
* Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Hands-on experience with ArgoCD and GitOps deployment methodologies.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep).
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of cloud security, governance, and compliance best practices.
* Experience with Azure networking, Application Gateway, Key Vault, and monitoring services.
* Experience in cloud cost management and optimization.
* Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
* Relevant Azure, Kubernetes, or DevOps certifications are a plus.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment.
* Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
* Focus on automation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

title: Platform Engineer - Datacenter Infrastructure
description:

We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**About Us**
F5 is a leading technology company dedicated to securing and optimizing applications across diverse on-premises, edge, and multi-cloud environments. We are looking for passionate individuals who are ready to help us build and scale resilient infrastructure that supports our global operations and innovative product suite.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Platform Engineer to modernize and automate our virtual machine and core infrastructure services that form the backbone of our data center and hybrid-cloud environments. * Apply GitOps principles for managing all infrastructure and service configurations, using pull requests for changes and enabling automated reconciliation.
* Lead the architecture, automation, and operational management of core infrastructure services, including enterprise DNS, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and NTP.
* Design, build, and maintain a centralized log aggregation to feed observability platform for infrastructure and applications.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate the testing, validation, and promotion of changes to core service configurations and infrastructure.
* Embed security and compliance into the entire sevice lifecycle, including secret management, certificate lifecycle automation, and vulnerability scanning.
* Implement monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for all managed services, and apply SRE principles to improve their reliability and performance.
* Collaborate with network, security, and application teams to ensure seamless integration and consumption of core services.

**Required Qualifications**

* +5 year experience working as a systems engineer or site reliability engineer supporting on-premise datacenter infrastructure and core infrastructure services
* Proficient with hypervisor technologies that support operating systems and containers (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Openshift)
* Proficient with automation and management of Windows Server and Linux VMs (eg Ubuntu, Redhat, Debian, etc)
* Deep hands-on experience engineering and automating core infrastructure services within a large-scale data center environment (e.g., DNS/BIND, Active Directory Certificate Services/PKI).
* Experience building container platform capabilities in an on-premise ecosystem.
* Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools, particularly Terraform and Ansible.
* Proven experience building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation (e.g., using GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools).
* Comfortable with Git-based workflows (PR reviews, branching strategies, versioning) and GitOps principles.
* Strong scripting and programming ability (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) to build automation, integrations, and tooling.
* Solid understanding of data center networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, firewalls) and security principles (least privilege, encryption, network security zones).
* Experience with centralized logging and observability platforms (e.g., Splunk, Elastic Stack, LogicMonitor).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with security and control frameworks such as NIST CSF, SOX, and ISO 27002.
* Experience working in hybrid-cloud environments and connecting on-premises services to public cloud providers (AWS, Azure).
* Knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes.
* Experience with platform engineering concepts like building internal tools and APIs to improve the developer/operator experience.

We are seeking a Staff Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing cloud-native database solutions running on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud. The solutions include relational and No-SQL products.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

title: Archt I-DevOps
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Highly technical, code-driven, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on accelerating the pre-sales cycle by building automated demo labs, scripting repetitive sales engineering tasks (like BOM generation and RFP parsing), and showcasing network automation capabilities to enterprise customers.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
High volume of scripting, API integration, and lab management. You will maintain internal code repositories, write Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates, manage automated demonstration portals, and execute high-speed Proof of Concepts (PoCs) concurrently.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
Moderate commercial risk. You are the technical automation engine for the team. While senior architects design the overarching telecom solutions, your code directly dictates how fast and effectively those solutions can be demonstrated and quoted. Broken scripts or failed API calls during a live demo can derail customer confidence and stall the sales cycle.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Pre-Sales Workflow Automation: Write scripts to eliminate manual pre-sales bottlenecks. Automate the generation of Bill of Materials (BOMs) by querying CPQ APIs, automate network diagramming, and use data parsing to accelerate RFP/RFI responses.
* Zero-Touch Provisioning (ZTP) Demonstrations: Build and maintain the scripts used in live customer pitches. You will help senior architects show (not just tell) customers how easily our telecom network can be provisioned and managed via APIs.
* API & Systems Integration: Serve as the team's API expert. Connect disparate pre-sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, CPQ, vendor portals, and internal lab hypervisors) to create a seamless, automated workflow for the Solutions Architecture team.
* NetDevOps Handoff: Revolutionize the pre-sales-to-delivery handoff. Instead of handing over Word documents, package your successful solution design as Git repositories, JSON payloads, and Ansible playbooks for the Implementation team to deploy instantly.
* Foundational Network Support: Understand the basics of the telecom and networking equipment you are automating (IP addressing, routing basics, firewalls) just enough to successfully write the code that provisions them.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in network automation, scripting, DevOps, or a heavily automated systems engineering role.
* Automation & Scripting: High proficiency in Python. Deep understanding of how to interact with RESTful APIs, manage authentication (OAuth, API keys), and parse data formats like JSON, YAML, and XML.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience with configuration management and provisioning tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Nornir.
* Version Control: Comfortable using Git and collaborative platforms like GitHub or GitLab to manage and document your code.
* Experience integrating or building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) to automate internal workflows, such as parsing dense technical RFPs or auto-generating technical documentation.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Industry certifications focused on automation, such as Cisco DevNet Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) applied to network infrastructure (NetDevOps).
* Basic Networking Context: Must understand foundational networking concepts (OSI model, IP Subnetting, basic routing, and what a firewall does) to know what your scripts are automating.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

build a career where ambition meets innovation?

LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We are proud to expand in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
  
  
When a production cloud incident hits a Tier 1 financial firm at 2 a.m., someone senior has to own it. As AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you're that person — the senior escalation point for LPL's run-the-cloud function, taking the hardest tickets and incidents end-to-end and turning recurring toil into automated, self-service paths. If you want to operate AWS at scale with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the AVP, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands-on senior cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE) — the run-the-cloud function for LPL's AWS multi-account landing zone. You are the senior escalation point for the Support team's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: you take the hardest tickets and production incidents end-to-end, own operational excellence, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alerting and runbooks. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in troubleshooting, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self-service paths — across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Operate as a hands-on senior cloud support engineer: spend the majority of your time in production troubleshooting, runbook authoring and execution, Terraform changes, complex ticket resolution, and incident response — hands-on operations is the primary leverage point
* Serve as the senior escalation point for the Support team's Tier 1 / Tier 2 queue: take the hardest tickets and production incidents end-to-end, and decide when to pull in the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, or Delivery. Turn recurring toil into durable fixes: convert repeatable account / IAM / access requests and incident classes into self-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Own operational excellence for the run-the-cloud function: runbook quality, change-management discipline in ServiceNow, post-incident reviews, and SLA / operational metrics; partner with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to close monitoring and alerting gaps. Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities to raise the run-the-cloud bar: AI-assisted triage and root-cause analysis, MCP-driven conversational self-service for common requests, automated runbook generation, and on-call copilots that summarize telemetry and chat during incidents
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a senior technical responder and escalation point for production incidents. Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to align roadmaps and remove cross-team and cross-pod blockers
* Raise engineering quality across the pod through code review, design partnership, and technical pairing — acting as a force multiplier without direct reports. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) and partner with the RTE and PMO on delivery commitments and dependencies

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 12+ years of progressive technical experience including 5+ years in a senior cloud security, network security, or cloud infrastructure engineering role; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 5+ years of hands-on production AWS at scale in a multi-account landing zone with strong production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions
* Demonstrated experience operating as a senior individual contributor (AVP, Senior Engineer, Staff Engineer, or equivalent), influencing technical direction and uplifting peer engineers without direct authority — including code review leadership, design-review participation, and technical mentorship
* Experience personally participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations in a fast-paced, security-conscious, regulated environment (financial services strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated experience as a senior engineer on a production cloud operations / support function: leading incident response as an escalation point, owning change management (ServiceNow or comparable ITSM), and driving runbook and automation improvements that reduce toil

**Core Competencies**

* Player-coach who is comfortable in code reviews, architecture sessions, and people 1:1s in the same day. Continuous learner, especially in cloud-native, IaC, platform engineering, and applied AI
* Sets vision and translates ambiguous strategy into executable engineering roadmaps. Bias for self-service, automation, and reducing toil for downstream internal customers
* Builds high-trust relationships across the US and India organization and across functions (Architecture, Security, FinOps, Application Engineering, Network, Audit). Calm, decisive incident commander; fosters a strong post-incident learning culture
* Excellent written and verbal communication, executive presence, and ability to influence without direct authority. Thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, regulated environments with imperfect information

**Preferences**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or MBA. Experience building, scaling, or leading globally distributed engineering teams across the US and India / GCC
* Experience integrating agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) into platform, IaC, and engineering practice. Strong scripting / programming proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* AWS Solutions Architect - Professional. AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Associate. Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004) or Authoring & Operations. Open-source contributions, public technical writing, or conference speaking on cloud, IaC, or platform engineering topics
* Experience with Backstage or another Internal Developer Platform (IDP). Experience with FinOps practices and cloud cost management at scale

title: Head DDIT ISC Software Development Governance, Integrity & Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
description:
**Summary**
We build and buy software that touches clinical trials, patient safety, manufacturing, quality systems and commercial operations. It now ships weekly rather than yearly, is increasingly AI-assisted, and increasingly contains AI. Our control framework was built for a slower world.
  
  
This role makes secure, compliant, audit-ready software delivery the fastest path for engineers — not a gate they route around. You will own the enterprise SDLC governance model and build much of it yourself: policy as code, automated evidence capture, pipeline controls and reference architectures.
  
  
This is a hands-on, individual-contributor leadership role. You will set enterprise direction, influence hundreds of engineers and lead through a federated community — but you will not have a large direct team, and you will spend meaningful time in repositories, pipelines and control code. Candidates seeking pure oversight or people management should not apply.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the enterprise policy, standards and controls for software engineering, including source control, branching, peer review, testing, release management, environment segregation, change control, configuration and release documentation.
* Rationalise overlapping GxP, SOX, privacy, security and IT-quality requirements into one coherent, risk-based framework, ensuring low-risk internal tools are not governed like regulated clinical systems.
* Retire SDLC controls that do not reduce risk and ensure tooling is implemented to securely speed up software development at Novartis at the highest scale, leveraging and creating AI tooling for the enterprise.
* Implement policy as code and controls as code, including branch protections, mandatory review, signed commits, segregation of duties, deployment approvals and immutable audit trails.
* Build automated, continuous evidence pipelines and define control telemetry including coverage, exceptions, drift, mean time to remediate and control effectiveness, with a focus on agility, automation and speed.
* Own secure-by-default guardrails in golden pipelines and paved-road platforms, aligning with recognized frameworks including NIST SSDF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62304 where applicable.
* Define controls for AI-assisted engineering, including acceptable use of coding assistants, agentic tooling, IP and licence exposure, provenance, attribution and human accountability for review and approval.
* Define controls for AI-containing products, including model lifecycle, dataset and model documentation, evaluation, drift monitoring, explainability, human oversight and readiness for evolving regulatory requirements.
* Use AI to reduce compliance burden through automated risk assessment drafting, control mapping, test generation, deviation triage and documentation synthesis, while serving as technical authority for inspections, audits, certifications and SDLC remediation.
* Lead a federated community of engineering, quality, security and compliance practitioners, publish practical guidance, advise senior leaders on risk and trade-offs, and partner with software developers across the enterprise to enable efficient delivery of compliant and secure products.

**Essential Requirement**

* You are a practitioner. You have substantial hands-on software engineering experience: you have written production code, owned CI/CD pipelines, and can read and modify pipeline configuration, IaC and policy code today, unaided. Expect a technical assessment.
* 10+ years in software engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps or engineering quality, including senior technical ownership of delivery pipelines at scale.
* Experience designing and operating automated controls in regulated environments — with evidence of replacing manual compliance work with software.
* Working fluency in regulated-software requirements relevant to pharma/life sciences: GxP, GAMP 5 (2nd Ed.), CSA, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and data integrity/ALCOA+.
* Security engineering depth: application security, software supply chain security, secrets and identity management, vulnerability management.
* Credible technical judgement on AI in the SDLC — both the tooling and its governance implications.
* Ability to influence without authority across engineering, quality and business lines, and hold positions with senior stakeholders and auditors.
* Excellent written English.

**Desirable Requirement**

* Experience in pharma, biotech, medical devices or another regulated industry (finance, aviation, nuclear), with real inspection or audit exposure.Experience with SOX ITGC in engineering contexts, IEC 62304 / SaMD, and privacy-by-design under GDPR.
* Hands-on with modern stacks: Git-based platforms and policy/protection features, container orchestration, cloud, IaC, policy engines (e.g. OPA/Rego or equivalent), test automation frameworks, SBOM and signing tooling.

You can find everything you need to know about our benefits and rewards in the Novartis Life Handbook. https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits-rewards

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
* Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
* Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production—holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.
* 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems—defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging—e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk.

You will have broad skills in implementing cloud solutions for various application architectures, scripting, databases and other data services ensuring the optimal level of documentation.
  
  
This role will implement and support cloud solutions on MS Azure and processes leveraged by large number of applications hosted in our environment. You will work with development teams to help increase automation and streamline build & deployment processes, apply best practices & principles. This role will engage with wider Deloitte Cloud and Security teams to ensure compliance and alignment with firm policy and assess impact of future strategies. You will design and support the growing demand for cloud technologies, including Kubernetes, Open AI, and implementations on Azure, creating & maintaining technical documentation for the Architects.
  
  
We are looking for individuals who are passionate about development, innovative and seek to continuously improve. We also expect you to comfortably transition between varying projects and priorities.
  
  

* Azure Platform and Environment Support: Monitors the T&L department’s tools and procedures and promotes their evolution alongside the business’s systems. He/She plays an active role in building and improving the platform services inclusive of websites, software, and applications while hosting and managing databases. Configure, deploy, and maintain Azure resources across development, testing, staging, and production environments. Support applications and services hosted on Azure Virtual Machines, App Services, Web Apps, Azure SQL, AKS, Azure Container Apps, and related platform services. Assist with onboarding and configuration of application, database, container, and data-service components. Maintain consistent environment configurations and support the setup of new environments. Contribute to scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure designs under established architecture and governance standards. Identify opportunities to optimize cloud resource utilization, AI service consumption, and operational costs while maintaining performance, availability, and reliability.
* CI/CD and Infrastructure Automation: Create, maintain, and monitor CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. Support continuous integration, continuous testing, application deployment, and release-management activities. Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, ARM templates, Terraform, or Bicep. Support infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployment validation, and recurring operational tasks. Maintain source-code repositories and branching processes using Git, Azure Repos, and TFVC. Contribute to repository and delivery-process migration from TFVC to Git.
* Application Reliability and Technical Support: Monitor application and infrastructure health using approved monitoring and observability tools. Investigate alerts, deployment failures, performance issues, connectivity problems, and service disruptions. Troubleshoot IIS, Azure API Management, Azure networking, firewall, NSG, and application connectivity issues. Resolve assigned incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs. Contribute to root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive measures. Support production releases, environment maintenance, and operational handover activities. Experience with cloud resource optimization, FinOps practices, or cloud and AI cost management is desirable.
* AI Enablement: Support the deployment and operation of AI-enabled applications using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, and related Azure services. Apply AIOps principles by leveraging monitoring data, automation, and AI-driven insights to proactively identify, investigate, and resolve incidents and improve platform reliability. Implement foundational integrations between enterprise applications and approved Azure AI services. Support AI workload using services such as Databricks, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Redis Cache, Azure SignalR, AKS, and Azure Container Registry. Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational support for AI-service integrations. Use approved AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, knowledge retrieval, and operational reporting. Validate AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations before use in project environments. Identify opportunities to apply automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve response times. Follow approved security, privacy, access, and data-handling practices when working with AI tools and services.
* Security, Monitoring, and Governance: Support the implementation of secure configurations for Azure resources, networking, access, secrets, and deployment processes. Assist with the integration and maintenance of code-quality, vulnerability, and security-scanning tools. Support monitoring solutions such as Application Insights, Azure Monitor, SolarWinds, Prometheus, and Grafana. Maintain accurate technical documentation, runbooks, configuration records, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Follow established engineering, security, change-management, and operational standards. Experience implementing advanced monitoring and observability capabilities, including dashboards, alerting, centralized logging, health checks, and proactive incident detection.
* Collaboration and Continuous Improvement: Work with Development, QA, Security, Infrastructure, Data, Architecture, and Operations teams to resolve technical dependencies. Share technical knowledge, reusable scripts, lessons learned, and operational improvements with the wider team. Adapt to changing priorities and contribute effectively across multiple projects and workstreams. Stay current with Azure, DevOps, automation, containerization, observability, and AI technology developments.

At Deloitte, we’re all about collaboration. And nowhere is this more apparent than among our 2,000-strong internal services team. With our combined specialist skills, we provide all the essential support and advice our client-facing colleagues need, right across the firm. This enables them to focus all of their efforts on delivering the best service possible to their clients. Covering seven distinct areas; Human Resources, Clients & Industries, Finance & Legal, Practice Support Services, Quality & Risk Services, IT Services, and Workplace Services & Real Estate, together we live, breathe and deliver the Deloitte experience.

Experience with Azure Virtual Machines, Azure SQL, App Services, Web Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Container Registry. Working knowledge of Azure API Management, Application Gateway, Databricks, Azure Cosmos DB, Redis Cache, and Azure SignalR. Practical experience with CI/CD pipeline configuration, monitoring, deployment orchestration, and continuous testing. Experience with Git, Azure Repos, TFVC, and source-code management practices.

company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a resourceful and experienced candidate to help lead technology operations for our Python Infrastructure team, based in the firm's offices in Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Gurugram. The Python Infrastructure team builds and maintains the Python foundation for the firm - infrastructure for analytic computations, data storage, and data services, high-performing data structures and data-analysis tools, parallel programming on the firm's grid, server infrastructure that other teams build on, and the firm's Python unit-testing and documentation infrastructure. These products underpin a large number of applications that are critical to the firm's day-to-day activities, which makes keeping them healthy, reliable, and fast a high-impact, senior operational responsibility. In this role, you will take broad ownership of the team's operational function, drive improvements that reduce manual toil, and mentor more junior members of the team — all within a high-quality environment with impeccable work standards.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
As a senior member of the team, you will handle operations for Python Infrastructure products while providing technical leadership for the operational function. Specifically, you will: Oversee CI pipelines and cron jobs — triaging build, test failures (including unit, speed, and memory tests) and import-performance regressions, driving fixes with the responsible developers, and ensuring these responsibilities are consistently covered. Spot repetitive manual work in the team's operations, such as triaging test failures, validating releases, and checking cron jobs, and automate it with reusable scripts and tools. Lead firmwide Python package upgrades — making our libraries compatible with each new version and planning the migration, with testing and fallback strategies to minimize disruption. Own release monitoring and release management for the team's repositories, including installing and validating cron jobs, releasing changes, and following up on post-release issues. Maintain an operational presence during the resolution of production issues, lead incident response, and escalate critical problems to minimize impact to users and the business.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A master’s or bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field
* 3-10 years of relevant industry experience
* Good proficiency in Python, with the ability to build and maintain operational tooling and to debug issues across unfamiliar libraries and components
* Hands-on experience operating in Linux/Unix environments and comfort with shell commands for monitoring and troubleshooting
* A good understanding of core computer science concepts, including operating systems and networking
* Good problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, with a detail-oriented mindset and the ability to scrutinize fine detail
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to work in a global and diverse team

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with version-control systems and Git, and a good understanding of the SDLC, including CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with Python testing frameworks (e.g., pytest)

description:
**Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Middleware Operations & Kafka)**
**About This Role**

* Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join the Middleware Operations team, with a primary focus on supporting and engineering enterprise Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments.
* The role is responsible for designing, deploying, operating, securing, and optimizing large-scale messaging infrastructure. The successful candidate will combine strong hands-on Kafka expertise with production support, automation, observability, risk management, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

**In This Role**

* Design, deploy, upgrade, and operate enterprise-scale Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform environments.
* Configure and manage KRaft controllers, brokers, Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, and Cluster Linking.
* Deploy and operate Confluent Platform on OpenShift Container Platform using the Confluent Operator.
* Provision and administer Kafka topics, ACLs, producers, consumers, partitions, retention policies, quotas, and replication settings.
* Configure Kafka security using TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and key rotation practices.
* Monitor and optimize platform performance, including JVM garbage collection, heap utilization, partition distribution, ISR health, disk capacity, throughput, and consumer lag.
* Troubleshoot production issues such as message loss or duplication, offset errors, broker failures, disk saturation, latency, throughput degradation, and consumer lag.
* Design and maintain platform health dashboards and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable enterprise monitoring tools.
* Automate provisioning, monitoring, recovery, regression testing, and operational activities using Python, Bash, Ansible, or similar technologies.
* Conduct capacity planning, performance benchmarking, and throughput optimization using tools such as KafkaPerf and kcat.
* Support incident, problem, change, and recovery management for business-critical middleware services, including root-cause analysis and preventive remediation.
* Develop infrastructure specifications, test solutions, support complex system upgrades, and contribute to application and infrastructure requirement validation.
* Establish long-term solutions for recurring production issues and identify opportunities to improve availability, resilience, and recovery time.
* Support risk and control initiatives by following technology policies, operating procedures, compliance requirements, and established work standards.
* Collaborate with application teams, engineering teams, cybersecurity partners, product managers, and infrastructure stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver platform objectives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, recovery procedures, architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in an on-call support rotation and provide implementation support for production releases and critical risk initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or equivalent experience demonstrated through work, education, training, or military experience.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience supporting large-scale middleware environments, including Apache Kafka and Confluent Platform.
* Strong production experience with Kafka brokers, KRaft, Schema Registry, REST Proxy, Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, and Cluster Linking.
* Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kafka on OpenShift using the Confluent Operator.
* Experience managing topics, ACLs, partitions, replication, retention, quotas, idempotent producers, and consumer groups.
* Strong troubleshooting experience covering consumer lag, broker crashes, offset issues, message loss or duplication, disk saturation, latency, and throughput problems.
* Experience implementing Kafka security using TLS, certificates, authentication, authorization, and enterprise key-management practices.
* Experience configuring Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for platform monitoring and health reporting.
* Proficiency in automation and scripting using Python, Bash, Ansible, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting highly available, enterprise production environments.
* Understanding of technology risk, control, compliance, and change-management practices within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance sector.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with KRaft migrations and upgrades from ZooKeeper-based Kafka environments.
* Knowledge of performance testing and benchmarking using KafkaPerf, kafkacat, or kcat.
* Experience with Confluent Cloud, Amazon MSK, or Azure Event Hubs for Apache Kafka.
* Knowledge of schema evolution, compatibility modes, and Avro, JSON, or Protobuf serialization.
* Experience with additional messaging technologies such as Solace, IBM MQ, or RabbitMQ.
* Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including routing, BGP, multicast, load balancing, DNS, and certificate management.
* Experience with capacity management, workload forecasting, and throughput optimization.
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, or similar monitoring and observability platforms.
* Confluent Certified Developer for Apache Kafka or Confluent Certified Administrator certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification.
* Job Expectations
* Ability to provide production implementation and operational support outside standard business hours when required.
* Ability to participate in an on-call rotation for critical incidents and service restoration.
* Ability to work in a controlled enterprise environment with strong risk, security, audit, and documentation requirements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineering teams, business partners, management, and control functions.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Data Platform Engineer, P4**
**Summary/objective**
The Senior Data Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical owner of isolved's data platform infrastructure and day-to-day operations, working within the architectural vision set by the data architecture team. This role carries a lighter architectural mandate, though architectural thinking is still highly valued, in exchange for deeper, more hands-on ownership of the systems that keep the platform running: administering and tuning Databricks and Snowflake, building and maintaining Fivetran, dbt, and Workato pipelines and integrations, and operating CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices in Terraform and GitHub Actions. This person is the engineer who configures, monitors, troubleshoots, and continuously improves isolved's data systems on a daily basis, escalating and partnering with the architects on larger design decisions while owning execution end to end.
  
  
**Core Job Duties**

* Administer and tune Databricks workspaces on a day-to-day basis, including Unity Catalog, access controls, service principals, cluster policies, secrets management, and cost optimization.
* Administer and tune Snowflake on a day-to-day basis, including warehouses, roles and RBAC, resource monitors, and secure data sharing configuration.
* Build, monitor, and maintain Fivetran connectors and incremental ingestion pipelines, troubleshooting sync failures and data quality issues as they arise.
* Build, test, and maintain dbt models, tests, and documentation, keeping transformation pipelines reliable and well-governed.
* Write and maintain Terraform modules to provision and manage Databricks, Snowflake, and cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or Azure) as code.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, primarily in GitHub Actions, to automate testing, deployment, and infrastructure changes across the data platform.
* Write PySpark and Python code to build, optimize, and maintain data processing jobs and internal automation tooling.
* Monitor platform and pipeline health, troubleshoot issues, and lead or support incident response and root-cause analysis for the data platform.
* Implement identity, access, and security controls (e.g., IAM, RBAC, secrets management) in line with standards set by the principal architects.
* Support pipeline orchestration (e.g., Airflow or equivalent) to sequence and monitor data workflows across ingestion, transformation, and delivery.
* Configure, maintain, and enhance data visualization tools like Power BI.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, documentation, and standards under the guidance of the Principal Platform Architect and Principal Data Architect, without owning target-state architecture directly.
* Partner with data engineering, data analytics, and the integrations team to translate architectural standards into working, well-operated systems.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, automation, and cost efficiency, and raise architectural implications to the principal architects when they extend beyond day-to-day execution.
* Document architectural diagrams, operational runbooks, configurations, and troubleshooting guides for the systems you own.

**Job Complexity**
Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex data platform issues creatively and effectively. Serves as the hands-on, go-to expert for isolved's data platform infrastructure, administration, and pipeline operations. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., peer or architecture review).
  
  
**Interaction**
Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside their own area of expertise.
  
  
**Supervision**
Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree; 6 years and a master's degree; or equivalent experience.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in data platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, data engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Seasoned customer engagement experience; professional services experience a huge plus.

title: Tech S And T-Cloud AI Platform Engineer-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:

10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform engineering expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. * Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.

**MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership**

* Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
* Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
* Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
* Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
* Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
* Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
* Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

**Asset and Accelerator Development**

* Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
* Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
* Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

**Business Development & GTM Initiatives**

* Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
* Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

**Program Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
* Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

**Practice Development & Team Leadership**

* Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
* Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
* Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).
  
  
**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.

* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

**Consulting & Leadership Experience:**

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

**Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.

**Portfolio Requirements:**
Hands-on experience in building production-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
