title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Life at Plume**
At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.
  
  
We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
  
  
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day.
  
  
This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing tools, processes and automations that help product engineers to do their work while ensuring the stability and reliability of our systems. This role requires skills in both software engineering and cloud-native infrastructure, as well as excellent communication skills and a collaborative spirit.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Implement, manage, and maintain scalable and reliable infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools.
* Develop and implement observability solutions to help engineers ensure high availability and performance of all services.
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to streamline the deployment process.
* Collaborate with development teams to ensure services are designed with operability and reliability in mind.
* Participate in a global on-call rotation to provide support for critical production systems.
* Drive down operational toil through automation and process improvements.
* Manage and optimize cloud resources for cost efficiency and performance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or similar role.
* Expertise in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Go).
* Experience with one or more cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP).
* Proficiency with configuration management and IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, Salt).
* Proficiency with Kubernetes-based environments
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch).
* Excellent technical communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with large-scale distributed systems.
* Knowledge of networking and security best practices.
* Familiarity with database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).

**Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**About Plume**
As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world’s largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.
  
  
Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume’s software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.
  
  
Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Associate Manager - WMS DevOps Service
description:
**Overview**
The purpose of this role is to support our growing global AWMS capability. We are seeking a DevOps analyst with strong warehouse process and IT knowledge to drive change adoption, transition to sustain (T2S) and build enterprise capability across the user base to reduce incidents and problems, driving day to day service delivery.
  
  
The successful candidate will help deliver and sustain the Affordable WMS (AWMS) roadmap, supporting the deployments envisaged across multiple markets, and will be part of the end-to-end IT centre of excellence for all markets who use the LEA Reply AWMS template.
  
  
This role requires a mix of business and technical acumen, stakeholder engagement, and a process optimisation mindset. The expectation is you will be hands-on, driving the delivery of key outcomes and continuous improvement in the service.
  
  
You will support the AWMS Service Manager in triaging, assigning, resolving (and acting as escalation point for critical) incidents, both during office hours and occasionally out of hours, coordinating with the vendor and with key IT capability teams to assure the end to end service excellence.
  
  
You will support the AWMS Delivery Lead in partnering with local BU/OU key users to take ownership of the solution and build capability within their facility, with a ‘train-the-trainer’ culture to drive adoption and reduce dependence on the vendor as well as on the global Enterprise Solutions team.
  
  
A key element of the role will be in implementation, driving process adoption and supporting key users as they learn business and IT processes. Once live, you will support the ‘business as usual’ (BAU) service management, helping with prioritisation of change requests across OUs & new demand, and documenting best practices as Knowledge Base articles in ServiceNow.
  
  
The core application in scope, LEA Reply, is a business critical 24/7 operational application essential to enable the fulfilment of demanding customer service targets across PepsiCo, part of PepsiCo’s critical Make Move Sell (MMS) application portfolio. This criticality applies to the end to end process, including integrated systems – primarily SAP ECC, but in some cases local automation solutions driving warehouse productivity (eg. ASRS, autonomous VNAs, conveyoring). As such the role entails critical BIL 1 Application SME accountability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Incident resolution for WMS and integrations, including interfaces with ERP (e.g., SAP), automation systems, and warehouse IT hardware ie. handheld terminals (HHTs) & printers.
* Core IT functional ownership of LEA Reply Europe (and potentially LATAM, subject to global op model evolution) assignment group to ensure ServiceNow incidents and problems are resolved to meet service levels.
* Devises, owns and manages transition to sustain (T2S) approach and service plan and service management for BAU (“business as usual”) to assure PepsiCo standard service continuity for markets once live.
* Supporting the AWMS sites and markets in non-vendor defects and issues, especially business process errors, user application errors, or broader competency-based issues.
* Maintains ServiceNow knowledge base of key articles to ensure supporting materials meet the needs of the user base.
* Incident resolution for other platforms and applications in the scope of our team, including but not limited to Global Network Design (Lyric)

**Qualifications**

* Candidate should have 6-7 Years of experience
* Fluent English.
* Warehouse process knowledge.
* ITIL – industry standard IT service management knowledge & experience.
* SAP ECC process knowledge.
* Demonstrable capability of building trust across different cultures, ability to manage challenging stakeholders at all levels. Strong communication, interpersonal and mentoring skills. Proven ability to influence and collaborate cross-functionally and with vendors.
* Autonomous self-starter – not afraid to get stuck into the detail (technical or functional) to get things moving and drive delivery or problem-solving when required. Flexibility to adapt to the demands of the moment – self-reliance & ability to adapt to a changing environment, to achieve the desired outcome.
* Ideal: LEA Reply WMS experience, SAP ECC user experience, warehouse automation integration experience, and broad knowledge of PepsiCo’s Supply Planning processes & systems.
* Ideal: proficiency in Jira / Confluence / ServiceNow / ADO, with service management experience, reporting to leadership level.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced DevOps leader with deep expertise in Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code? Do you enjoy building cloud platforms that are secure, scalable, and cost-efficient, and helping other engineers improve along the way? If you like hands-on technical leadership at the point where cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and software delivery meet, we want you on our team.
  
  
As a Staff DevOps Engineer, you'll lead the design and growth of our cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and software delivery practices. You'll lead by example, drive application and platform modernization, and build engineering patterns that teams across the organization can reuse. You'll work closely with software engineering, architecture, security, and product teams to deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
  
  
**About The Role**
**In this role as a Staff DevOps Engineer, you will:**

* Cloud platforms and delivery pipelines become more secure, scalable, and reliable, and easier for engineering teams to use.
* Application modernization and Kubernetes adoption move forward through practical, reusable patterns.
* Automation, standardization, and GitOps improve deployment quality and engineering productivity.
* Cloud costs are actively managed, with measurable savings and effective governance.
* The team gets stronger through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and higher technical standards.
* Build and run cloud platforms: Design, build, and run secure, scalable, highly available cloud-native platforms on Microsoft Azure and AWS. On Azure, you'll build with App Service, Function Apps, AKS, API Management, Key Vault, Service Bus, Logic Apps, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Storage, Virtual Machines, and Azure AI Foundry. On AWS, you'll build with EC2, Lambda, Elastic Beanstalk, Textract, API Gateway, storage, and related services.
* Lead application modernization and Kubernetes: Lead the move of legacy and .NET applications to cloud-native, containerized architectures. Own Kubernetes and AKS architecture, deployment, security, scalability, resiliency, and day-to-day operations, including GPU-based AI and machine learning workloads. Use Helm to standardize how applications are packaged and deployed, and create platform patterns that can be reused across applications, teams, and environments.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation: Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Bicep. Create infrastructure modules and deployment patterns that are reusable, secure, compliant, and version-controlled. Expand automation and self-service so developers can deliver faster and more consistently.
* Improve CI/CD and GitOps: Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Workflows, GitHub Actions, and Argo CD. Advance GitOps practices and automated deployment strategies across environments to increase deployment frequency, release quality, reliability, and engineering productivity.
* Strengthen networking, observability, and reliability: Design and troubleshoot cloud networking, including VNets, subnets, network interfaces (NICs), private endpoints, DNS, load balancing, and network security. Set up monitoring and observability with Datadog, Azure Application Insights, and related tools. Define useful alerts, health indicators, and incident response practices. Lead root cause analysis to stop incidents from happening again.
* Optimize cloud costs: Find and lead cost optimization work across Azure and AWS. Balance cost, performance, security, reliability, and scalability in architecture decisions. Promote practical governance, resource usage standards, and engineering ownership of cloud spend.
* Lead and mentor: Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on cloud, DevOps, and platform engineering. Mentor engineers, constructively challenge existing approaches, and raise the bar for architecture, automation, quality, and delivery. Lead the creation of reference architectures, technical standards, and best practices. Shape platform strategy and explain decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**About You**
**You're a fit for the role of Staff DevOps Engineer if you have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Deep experience with cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, serverless services, storage, virtual machines, managed application platforms, messaging, APIs, and both relational and NoSQL databases.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and AKS, including application modernization and GPU workload deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Helm for Kubernetes package management.
* Skill in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Bicep.
* Strong CI/CD experience with GitHub Workflows, GitHub Actions, and Argo CD.
* Experience deploying and supporting .NET applications.
* Good working knowledge of Linux.
* Skill in Shell scripting and Python.
* Experience with Datadog, Azure Application Insights, or similar monitoring and observability tools.
* A track record of finding and delivering cloud cost savings.
* Working knowledge of Azure AI Foundry.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration, communication, and mentoring skills.
* Experience building shared platform engineering capabilities used by multiple product teams.
* Experience putting enterprise-scale GitOps and cloud governance practices in place.
* Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, generative AI solutions, or GPU-enabled infrastructure.
* Relevant Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications.
* Experience working in a complex enterprise or regulated software environment.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Position Summary
  
  
The Observability Engineer builds the monitoring, tracing, and logging infrastructure that provides visibility into Rimini Street's Agentic AI ERP Platform. You will ensure that operators, developers, and customers can understand system behavior, diagnose issues, and optimize performance across the distributed platform.
  
  
Reporting to the Sr Director Engineering – India, this role is critical for production operations and customer trust. You will implement OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation, build dashboards and alerting, and create the observability foundation that enables reliable AI agent operations in enterprise ERP environments.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
**Observability Infrastructure**

* Design and implement observability architecture using OpenTelemetry as the foundation.

* Build metrics collection and storage using Prometheus, Thanos, or Cortex.
* Implement centralized logging with structured log formats and efficient querying.
* Ensure observability infrastructure scales with platform growth and customer deployments.

**Instrumentation & Integration**

* Define instrumentation standards for Java (Quarkus), Python, and Angular applications.
* Implement automatic and manual instrumentation for MCP servers and agent workflows.
* Create trace context propagation across service boundaries and ERP system calls.
* Build custom metrics for AI agent behavior, LLM performance, and RAG retrieval quality.

**Dashboards & Visualization**

* Create Grafana dashboards for platform health, performance, and business metrics.
* Build customer-facing dashboards showing agent activity and processing status.
* Design SLI/SLO dashboards and error budget tracking.
* Implement trace visualization for debugging complex agent workflows.
* Create documentation and training materials for dashboard usage.

**Alerting & Incident Response**

* Design alerting strategies that balance signal quality with noise reduction.
* Implement multi-level alerting with appropriate escalation paths.
* Build runbooks linking alerts to diagnostic procedures and remediation steps.
* Support incident response with observability expertise and root cause analysis.

**Experience**

* 4-6 years in observability, SRE, or platform engineering roles.
* Experience implementing observability for distributed systems or microservices.
* Track record building dashboards and alerting for production systems.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry or similar instrumentation frameworks.
* Background in enterprise software or B2B SaaS preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**

* Strong expertise in OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics, logs).
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting systems.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing with Jaeger, Zipkin, or similar tools.
* Experience with log aggregation (ELK stack, Loki, or similar).
* Programming skills in Python, Java, or Go for instrumentation and tooling.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Kubernetes observability and service mesh telemetry.
* Knowledge of AI/ML observability, including LLM monitoring.
* Familiarity with Quarkus and Python instrumentation.
* Experience with SLI/SLO frameworks and error budgets.
* Understanding of PromQL, LogQL, and TraceQL query languages.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work in distributed, multi-timezone teams.
* Data-driven mindset with focus on actionable insights.
* Collaborative approach to working with development and operations teams.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
* Grafana, Prometheus, or observability platform certifications.
* CKA or cloud platform certifications.

Fluent English required.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to own and enhance CI/CD, build and release automation, engineering quality, security scanning and performance-testing capabilities across the Guidewire application landscape.

* Support release planning, production deployments, rollback readiness and operational handover.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

* Proven experience implementing and supporting enterprise CI/CD pipelines and production deployment processes.
* Strong knowledge of Git-based development, DevSecOps controls, scripting and release automation.

title: Staff DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Staff DevOps Engineer, you will play a critical leadership role in GE Vernova Grid Software's mission of enabling a more sustainable, reliable, and resilient energy future by defining and executing the DevOps strategy across the Transmission portfolio, spanning both heritage products and GridOS-based solutions. You will drive the transformation of software delivery practices, modernize build and release ecosystems, establish enterprise-scale CI/CD standards, and accelerate engineering productivity through automation, cloud-native platforms, and DevSecOps practices.
  
  
Leveraging deep expertise in DevOps, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, automation, release engineering, observability, and platform engineering, you will lead the design and implementation of scalable engineering systems that enable reliable, secure, and predictable software delivery across a diverse product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, product teams, cybersecurity teams, and infrastructure organizations to establish common DevOps frameworks, deployment standards, and operational excellence practices.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong technical leadership, hands-on implementation experience, and a proven track record of driving large-scale DevOps transformations across complex enterprise software environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Define and own the DevOps vision, strategy, roadmap, and implementation across the Transmission Software portfolio, including both heritage EMS/SCADA products and GridOS-native applications.
* Lead the standardization and modernization of CI/CD platforms, build systems, release pipelines, artifact management, and deployment automation across multiple product lines.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices, integrating security scanning, compliance checks, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement into engineering workflows.
* Establish enterprise-wide standards for source control, branching models, automated testing, release governance, environment management, and deployment processes.
* Partner with engineering teams to enable cloud-native development practices leveraging containers, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and platform engineering principles.
* Design and implement scalable automation frameworks that improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, and accelerate software delivery cycles.
* Lead modernization initiatives to transition legacy build, deployment, and release processes toward highly automated and self-service platforms.
* Partner with product engineering and quality organizations to achieve best-in-class automation coverage, deployment reliability, release quality, and operational readiness.
* Define and track key DevOps metrics, including deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR, pipeline efficiency, and engineering productivity.
* Drive implementation of observability solutions including logging, monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational dashboards across portfolio products.
* Collaborate with cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and platform teams to ensure highly available, secure, and scalable engineering environments.
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, implementation guidance, mentoring, and coaching of DevOps engineers and development teams.
* Champion Agile, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Platform Engineering best practices throughout the organization.
* Partner with global engineering teams to improve release predictability, deployment consistency, operational excellence, and customer delivery outcomes.
* Drive portfolio-wide initiatives to reduce technical debt, improve developer experience, and establish a modern software delivery ecosystem.

Desired Characteristics
  
  

* Deep expertise in DevOps, CI/CD, Release Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Software Delivery at enterprise scale.
* Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD platforms using technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar frameworks.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, or GCP, and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, container orchestration, and platform automation.
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent.
* Experience building enterprise-scale deployment automation and release management processes supporting multiple global development teams.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps, application security, compliance automation, vulnerability management, and secure software delivery practices.
* Expertise in observability platforms including Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies.
* Experience supporting both legacy enterprise applications and modern microservices-based architectures.
* Strong understanding of software quality engineering, automated testing strategies, test orchestration, and quality gates.
* Knowledge of power systems, transmission operations, EMS, SCADA, GridOS, utility software, or industrial control systems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering organizations, drive transformation initiatives, and build consensus across multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, and organizational change management skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or related STEM discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, DevOps Engineering, Platform Engineering, Release Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience leading DevOps transformation initiatives across enterprise software organizations.
* Strong hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms, cloud technologies, automation tooling, infrastructure management, and software delivery systems.
* Demonstrated experience driving organization-wide engineering productivity, automation, and modernization programs.

**Technical Skills & Additional Experience**

* CI/CD Platforms: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
* Cloud Platforms: Azure, AWS, GCP
* Container Technologies: Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Helm, Ansible
* Source Control & SCM: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk, OpenTelemetry
* Security: DevSecOps, SAST, DAST, SBOM, Container Security
* Release Engineering & Environment Management
* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
* Platform Engineering & Internal Developer Platforms
* Automated Testing & Quality Engineering
* Enterprise Software Delivery and Portfolio Governance

Leadership Expectations
  
  

* Serve as the technical leader for DevOps strategy and execution across the entire Transmission portfolio.
* Drive alignment between GridOS and heritage product teams to establish common DevOps standards and reusable platforms.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering, Product Management, Quality Engineering, Cybersecurity, Cloud Infrastructure, and Customer Delivery teams.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads while fostering a culture of automation, quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Define and report portfolio-level engineering health metrics and continuously improve software delivery performance.

title: Production Application Support Lead
description:
You will own the stability, availability and performance of our production platforms. This is a hands-on lead/manager role that combines production support, DevOps and site reliability engineering (SRE). You will lead engineers, run major incidents, and read the code to find root causes. You will also use AI tools to cut toil and resolve incidents faster.
  
  
**What We Expect Of You**
Accountable. You keep an eye on everything. Every production service, alert, incident and risk in your scope is yours to know about, and nothing should surprise you.
  
  
Responsible. The buck stops with you. When production is at risk, you know what to do, you decide, and you see it through to resolution.
  
  
Leadership. You own your team. You set the standard for on-call, coach engineers, back them during incidents, and answer for their results.
  
  
Technical. You know your stuff. You go deep on the platform, the data stores, the pipelines and the code, and your team trusts your judgment because you have done the work.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Production support and reliability**
‒ Lead the production support function, including on-call rotations, escalation paths and 24x7 coverage.
  
  
‒ Command major incidents from detection through resolution, then run blameless post-incident reviews and drive the fixes to completion.
  
  
‒ Define and track service level indicators (SLIs), service level objectives (SLOs) and error budgets with engineering and product teams.
  
  
‒ Use Datadog to build monitoring, alerting and dashboards that catch problems before users do.
  
  
‒ Run and improve Kubernetes workloads in the cloud, including scaling, upgrades, capacity and cost.
  
  
‒ Support and tune PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Neo4j in production, including performance, backup, recovery and failover.
  
  
‒ Keep Confluent Kafka healthy: throughput, consumer lag, partitioning, retention and schema management.
  
  
‒ Strengthen CI/CD pipelines, release practices, rollback plans and infrastructure as code.
  
  
‒ Report on availability, incident trends, mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) to senior leaders.
  
  
‒ Hire, coach and develop a high-performing team.
  
  
**Incident and problem management**
‒ Own the end-to-end incident management process: detection, triage, severity classification, escalation, communication, resolution and closure.
  
  
‒ Act as incident commander for Sev 1 and Sev 2 events, coordinating engineering, vendors and business stakeholders, and issuing clear status updates to leadership at set intervals.
  
  
‒ Own problem management: run root cause analysis (RCA), maintain the known error database, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
  
  
‒ Identify recurring incidents through trend analysis, and prioritize permanent fixes ahead of repeat firefighting.
  
  
‒ Set and enforce service level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution, and report breaches with causes and remedies.
  
  
‒ Run change and release risk reviews with the change advisory board (CAB), and link incidents back to the changes that caused them.
  
  
‒ Maintain on-call runbooks, escalation matrices and major incident playbooks, and test them through regular incident drills.
  
  
‒ Run weekly and monthly incident, problem and service health reviews with engineering, product and business owners.
  
  
‒ Manage third-party and vendor escalations for cloud, platform and software issues, and hold vendors to their support commitments.
  
  
‒ Keep the incident and problem tooling (for example ServiceNow or Jira) accurate, and ensure tickets carry complete timelines, impact and root cause.
  
  
**Quality, CSAT and team performance**
‒ Design and run a customer satisfaction (CSAT) process for all production support resources, with a survey after ticket closure, a defined target score and a review of every low score.
  
  
‒ Gather CSAT from business users, application owners and engineering partners, and turn the feedback into coaching and process fixes.
  
  
‒ Create quality gates for ticket handling: accurate categorization and priority, complete root cause and resolution notes, correct escalation, and knowledge article updates before closure.
  
  
‒ Audit a sample of closed tickets each month against the quality gates, score each engineer and team, and share results openly.
  
  
‒ Create release and handover gates, such as production readiness, runbook and monitoring sign-off, before a service moves to support.
  
  
‒ Measure quantitative performance for each support team and engineer: ticket volume, backlog and aging, first response time, time to resolve, SLA attainment, reopen rate, first-contact resolution and escalation rate.
  
  
‒ Build dashboards that combine quality and quantity metrics, so no one is rewarded for closing tickets fast at the cost of quality.
  
  
‒ Set targets and thresholds for each metric, run corrective plans where teams miss them, and recognize teams that exceed them.
  
  
‒ Use the data in performance reviews, capacity planning and staffing decisions, and report trends to senior leaders every month.
  
  
**Hands-on technical work**
‒ Troubleshoot live production issues hands-on: pod crashes, node pressure, network policies, DNS, ingress, certificates and resource limits in Kubernetes.
  
  
‒ Analyze application logs, distributed traces, thread dumps, heap dumps and metrics to isolate root cause across microservices.
  
  
‒ Review code changes, configuration and release diffs to find the commit, dependency or setting behind a regression.
  
  
‒ Tune PostgreSQL queries, indexes, connection pools, vacuum and replication. Diagnose MongoDB slow operations, sharding and replica set issues, and Neo4j query plans and memory.
  
  
‒ Monitor and resolve Kafka issues: consumer lag, rebalancing, partition skew, broker health, connector failures and schema compatibility.
  
  
‒ Build and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Helm charts, and review changes made by the team.
  
  
‒ Write automation in Python, Bash or PowerShell for remediation, health checks and routine operations.
  
  
‒ Troubleshoot CI/CD pipeline failures, build and deployment issues, and container image and registry problems.
  
  
‒ Run load, failover and chaos tests to validate resilience, and fix the gaps they expose.
  
  
‒ Manage identity, secrets, certificates and network access in the cloud, working with security teams on vulnerabilities and patching.
  
  
‒ Tune cloud and cluster capacity, autoscaling and cost.
  
  
‒ Write and keep current runbooks, architecture diagrams and dependency maps for production services.
  
  
‒ Use Copilot and other AI tools to speed up log analysis, query tuning, script writing and incident summaries, and validate every output before it touches production.
  
  
**Architecture and design**
‒ Review solution architecture and design documents for new and changing services, and flag reliability, scalability, security and operability risks before release.
  
  
‒ Map service dependencies, data flows and failure domains across the microservices estate. Use that view to set resilience patterns such as retries, circuit breakers, timeouts and graceful degradation.
  
  
‒ Partner with architects and engineering leads on platform design decisions, including multi-region and disaster recovery strategy, data store selection, and event-driven patterns on Kafka.
  
  
‒ Set production readiness standards, and gate releases on them: observability, SLOs, runbooks, rollback plans and capacity.
  
  
**Code analysis**
‒ Read and analyze application code to understand behavior in production, including concurrency, memory use, query patterns, error handling and retry logic.
  
  
‒ Review pull requests for operational risk, such as missing logging, unbounded queries, weak error handling and unsafe configuration.
  
  
‒ Trace recurring incidents back to design or code defects, and work with development teams to fix them permanently.
  
  
‒ Use static analysis, dependency scanning and code quality tools to find reliability and security risks early.
  
  
**Platform engineering and AI-driven automation**
‒ Build and improve internal platform capabilities such as self-service environments, standard pipeline templates, golden paths and reusable Helm and infrastructure modules.
  
  
‒ Use AI tools, including GitHub Copilot, to generate and review automation scripts, pipeline code, infrastructure as code and runbooks, then test and validate before release.
  
  
‒ Apply AI to operational workflows: alert triage, log and trace summarization, incident timelines, post-incident report drafts and ticket classification.
  
  
‒ Automate remediation of known failure patterns through self-healing scripts, event-driven workflows and auto-scaling policies.
  
  
‒ Measure toil, set automation targets, and report time saved, incident reduction and MTTR improvement from AI and automation work.
  
  
‒ Define guardrails for AI use in production, including access controls, review requirements and audit trails.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Required**
‒ 10+ years in production support, DevOps or SRE, including at least three years leading teams.
  
  
‒ Career progression from on-premises infrastructure or systems administration into cloud administration, DevOps and SRE, and then into technical leadership. You understand the full stack from hardware, networking and operating systems up to cloud-native services, and you use that depth to troubleshoot.
  
  
‒ Deep hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, Azure or AWS (compute, networking, identity, monitoring, resilience).
  
  
‒ Production-level Kubernetes expertise on a managed service such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), including troubleshooting, Helm and deployment strategies.
  
  
‒ Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Neo4j operations.
  
  
‒ Experience running Confluent Kafka in production.
  
  
‒ Strong grounding in microservices architecture, including service dependencies, API failures and distributed tracing.
  
  
‒ Proven use of Datadog or comparable observability platforms.
  
  
‒ CI/CD experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  
  
‒ Ability to read and debug code in at least one major language, for example Java, C# or Python.
  
  
‒ Track record managing high-severity incidents and communicating clearly with technical and business audiences.
  
  
‒ Practical experience applying AI tools, such as Copilot, in engineering or operations work.
  
  
**Preferred**
‒ Terraform or Bicep experience.
  
  
‒ ITIL or similar service management practices.
  
  
‒ Azure, AWS, Kubernetes or SRE certifications.
  
  
‒ Experience in a regulated or large-scale enterprise environment.
  
  
**How You Will Be Measured**
Availability against SLOs, MTTD and MTTR, repeat-incident rate, CSAT scores, ticket quality gate results, SLA attainment, on-call health, automation gains, and the quality of post-incident follow-through.

description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.
* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.
* Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts.
* Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue.js, or another modern front-end framework.
* Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology.
* Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications.
* Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results.
* Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment.
* Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment.
* Familiarity with IT service-management processes and tools such as ServiceNow.
* Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications.
* Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-hosted application architectures.
* Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools.
* Experience supporting API-based or middleware-based system integrations.
* Exposure to application lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patching, and technical-debt remediation.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams involving business stakeholders, vendors, infrastructure, security, and application-development teams.

**Ready to Apply for the Job?**

You can then complete your Workday profile in minutes with the “Upload My Experience” functionality to upload an updated copy of your resume, or you can simply edit the individual sections of your Career Profile.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.
  
  
Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
  
  
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.
  
  
Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.
  
  
AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
  
  
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.
  
  
Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually

**Our Tenets**

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- Amazon Dev Center India - Hyderabad

title: Site Reliability Engineer I
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**
NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Global Command Center (GCC) Site Reliability Engineer (I) is responsible for monitoring and supporting business-critical applications and infrastructure across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. The role provides first-level event and incident response while supporting day-to-day reliability operations, including infrastructure maintenance, certificate management, deployments, observability, and production support.
  
  
The engineer works closely with application, infrastructure, cloud, DevOps, network, and SRE teams to maintain service availability, minimize business impact, and continuously improve operational reliability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Monitor applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and customer-facing services for availability, performance, and reliability.
* Analyze, acknowledge, prioritize, and triage alerts and events, performing initial troubleshooting and escalation as required.
* Provide L1 production support and participate in incident and major incident response.
* Support monitoring and observability using tools such as AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, and ServiceNow Event Management.
* Perform routine infrastructure maintenance and server patching across Azure, GCP, AWS, VMware, Windows, and Linux environments.
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, including monitoring, renewal, installation, validation, and expiration prevention.
* Execute and validate application deployments following established change and release processes.
* Support Operational Readiness Reviews by validating monitoring, alerting, runbooks, escalation paths, and support procedures.
* Identify recurring incidents, monitoring gaps, and operational risks and contribute to service improvements.
* Support automation of repetitive operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or APIs.
* Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, incident records, and operational documentation.
* Follow established incident, problem, change, and event management processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 0-2 years of experience in Event Management, Production Support, SRE, NOC/Command Center, DevOps, or Infrastructure Operations.
* Working knowledge of Azure, GCP, and/or AWS.
* Understanding of monitoring, incident management, server administration, networking, SSL/TLS certificates, and deployment processes.
* Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 shift-based support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise monitoring/observability and ITSM tools.
* Basic scripting knowledge in PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
* Exposure to CI/CD and automation.
* Understanding of SRE concepts including SLI/SLO/SLA, MTTD, MTTR, availability, and resiliency.
* Azure, GCP, or AWS certification is a plus.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Event and incident management
* Technical troubleshooting
* Operational discipline and attention to detail
* Customer focus and ownership
* Communication and collaboration
* Prioritization and decision-making under pressure
* Continuous improvement mindset

Success Measures
  
  
Success will be measured through effective event detection and response, service availability, reduction in MTTD/MTTR and recurring incidents, monitoring effectiveness, successful certificate renewals and deployments, infrastructure maintenance compliance, automation adoption, and reduced customer impact.
  
  
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job
  
  
**EEO Statement**
Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.
  
  
**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III**
**Role Overview:**
As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte’s engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
* Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
* Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production—holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.
* 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems—defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging—e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk.
* 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management.
* Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production—their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side.
* Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution).
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
