title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. ****Job Description****
**Specialist, Cloud Data Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are looking for Software Engineers (SE) who can break down and solve complex problems with a strong motivation to get things done with a boots-on-the-ground, pragmatic mindset! Our engineers own their products end to end and influence the way how our products and technology are deployed to facilitate most aspects of drug discovery impacting hundreds of thousands of patients around the world. We are looking for engineers who can creatively handle complex dependencies and ambiguous requirements, competing business priorities, while producing fit-for-purpose, optimal solutions.
  
  
We are hoping that you are passionate about collaborating across the interface between hard-core software development and research and discovery data analysis.
  
  
Our Engineering team builds core components used by our company's Research Labs’ data analytics, visualization, and management workflows. The analysis tools and pipelines built for data processing by our team in partnership with our scientists aim to accelerate research and the discovery of new therapies for our patients.
  
  
We collect, annotate, analyze petabytes of scientific data (multi-omics, chemistry, imaging, safety) used in biomarker research, drug safety/efficacy, drug target discovery, and compendium diagnostic development. We help our scientists to process, analyze scientific data at scale by developing highly parallelized analytical workflows ran on HPC infrastructure (on-prem & cloud); to manage, explore and visualize various scientific data modalities by developing bespoke data models, bioinformatics ETL processes, data retrieval and visualization services using distributed micro-service architecture, FAIR data principles, SPA type dashboards, industry specific regulatory compliant data integrity, auditing, and security access controls.

* Proven ability (3+ years hands-on experience).
* Data manipulation using Linux command line tools, batch processing.
* Large data processing, data consistency validation.
* Experience with bioinformation pipeline, data formats (FastQ, BAM) is huge advantage.

This role will lead the design, development, and engineering of enterprise observability solutions supporting application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, telemetry collection, and AI-enabled operational intelligence.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide technical leadership for cloud-native observability platforms including Splunk Observability Cloud (SPLOC), AppDynamics, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, and related telemetry services. This role requires strong software engineering expertise combined with deep knowledge of observability technologies, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise-scale monitoring solutions.
  
  
In This Role, You Will
  
  

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise observability and distributed tracing solutions.
* Design and develop cloud-native applications, APIs, and services using Java, Spring Boot, and modern microservices architectures.
* Build scalable telemetry platforms and services supporting enterprise monitoring, tracing, and performance analytics.
* Design and implement OpenTelemetry instrumentation standards, frameworks, and telemetry collection architectures.
* Develop and maintain tracing pipelines, collectors, gateways, and associated observability infrastructure.
* Deploy and support applications and services on Kubernetes and OpenShift environments.
* Develop automated solutions for instrumentation, telemetry onboarding, platform upgrades, compliance validation, and operational monitoring.
* Build reusable software components that enable enterprise adoption of observability standards.
* Drive integration of observability platforms with enterprise automation, incident management, and operational tooling.
* Evaluate and implement AI-driven observability capabilities including anomaly detection, intelligent troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Influence enterprise observability strategy, standards, and best practices.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives and teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Technology Infrastructure Engineering and Solutions experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Software Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, or related experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with enterprise observability platforms including Splunk Observability Cloud (SignalFx/SPLOC), AppDynamics, or Dynatrace.
* Strong experience designing and developing microservices and RESTful APIs.
* Deep understanding of OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, telemetry pipelines, and observability concepts.
* Experience deploying and supporting applications on Kubernetes and containerized platforms.
* Experience with MongoDB or similar NoSQL databases including data modeling and performance optimization.
* Experience with Kafka and event-driven architectures.
* Strong understanding of enterprise monitoring, application performance management, and reliability engineering practices.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives and influence engineering decisions across organizations.
* Experience implementing OpenTelemetry solutions at enterprise scale.
* Experience designing and operating large-scale observability platforms.
* Knowledge of GenAI, LLMs, AI Agents, AIOps, and intelligent operational workflows.
* Experience integrating observability platforms with ServiceNow, automation frameworks, and incident management solutions.
* Experience with OpenShift and cloud-native platform engineering.
* Experience supporting large-scale modernization, migration, or cloud transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevSecOps practices.
* Industry certifications in Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts — and humans stay in control.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop — observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify — across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation
* Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over
* Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment
* Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs
* Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes
* Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR
* Build evaluation and observability for the agents themselves: trace agent reasoning and tool calls, measure accuracy, action success rate, false-action rate, latency, and cost; run replay/simulation and chaos tests before increasing autonomy in production
* Partner with SRE, platform, and application teams to onboard services to autonomous operations, set standards and reusable patterns, and coach engineers on using AI + observability to automate their own operational workflows

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  

* 10+ years overall experience with 5+ years in SRE, AIOps, observability, or platform engineering.
* Proven hands-on development of autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent; strong grasp of tool/function calling, MCP, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
* Deep service observability expertise: OpenTelemetry, , Grafana, , Jaeger/Tempo, or enterprise APM (Splunk, AppDynamics); strong PromQL/LogQL/SQL and SLO/SLI/error-budget design
* Track record of delivering closed-loop auto-remediation in production that measurably reduced MTTR, alert noise, or manual toil, with clear safety controls and rollback
* Strong Python (Go a plus) with experience building event-driven services and integrations across Kubernetes, CI/CD, ITSM (ServiceNow), and automation tools.
* Practical knowledge of applied ML and LLM techniques for operations: anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, event correlation, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation of LLM outputs
* Understanding of responsible and secure AI in regulated environments: least-privilege agent access, PII redaction, auditability, model risk management, and change-control compliance
* Demonstrated technical leadership, with experience mentoring and leading engineers, setting engineering direction, reviewing designs, and developing team capability while influencing risk partners and senior stakeholders

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* Provides guidance and mentorship to less senior team members.
* Supports cross-functional teams and influences technical direction for information security solutions.
* Rotational after-hours and weekend support is required.

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:**

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related technical discipline

* Strong expertise in process automation and workflow orchestration

title: Engineer II - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
  
  
Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
  
  
Cloud Support engineers at LPL run the cloud — they're the first humans on every ticket from an application team and the people who turn 'this happened again' into 'we automated it.' As Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll triage tickets, execute runbooks, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents inside the Support team, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support close at hand. If you want to learn AWS at a Tier 1 financial firm by running it for real with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support LPL's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 production support for the AWS landing zone — the run-the-cloud function inside CCOE — alongside senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support. Day-to-day you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, execute and improve runbooks, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alert routing into ServiceNow and runbook execution, and you escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when the issue is beyond the Support team's remit. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in tickets, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self-service paths.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs: own the ticket end-to-end if it's Tier 1 / Tier 2 scope, and escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when it's not
* Fulfill account / IAM / access requests for the landing zone and actively turn the repeatable ones into self-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Execute and improve runbooks for known incident classes; pair with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to feed incident lessons back into durable monitoring and runbook improvements
* Support change-management execution: change-window participation, ServiceNow change-record discipline, and verification of changes against the affected accounts and workloads
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day-to-day support work: AI-assisted ticket triage and routing, conversational self-service for common account / IAM / access requests via MCP, runbook generation and lookup, and on-call copilots that summarize recent telemetry and chat during incidents
* Operate as a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 3+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1+ years of hands-on production AWS in a multi-account environment with hands-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands-on experience working a production cloud operations or cloud support queue (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable ITSM): ticket triage SLAs, runbook execution, account / IAM / access-request fulfillment, change-window participation, and primary on-call response

**Core Competencies**

* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high-quality, well-tested, code-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description

**Preferences**

* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day-to-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

title: Sr Devops + AIOps engineer
description:
**Position : Sr Devops + AIOps engineer**

We are seeking an experienced AWS DevSecOps and AIOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes (EKS/ECS), cloud security, and observability tools such as Datadog. The role involves automating infrastructure, integrating security into deployment pipelines, optimizing cloud costs, implementing disaster recovery, and building AI-driven monitoring and self-healing solutions using AWS Bedrock and related services. Strong scripting, troubleshooting, and cross-functional collaboration skills are essential.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain automation pipelines supporting Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery using Harness or GitHub Actions.
* Strong Expertise on building IAC using Terraform .
* Provide critical support on AWS cloud environments
* Integrate Datadog and create custom dashboards, alerts and log pipelines for continuous monitoring and observability.
* AWS resource provisioning, management, architecture with a focus on cost and optimization
* Lead projects & initiatives to completion to improve and streamline operational processes and maximize resources
* Interface with other teams to resolve complex issues that have implications beyond your own area
* Assess infrastructure and application vulnerabilities and take remediation actions as appropriate.
* Change management and Incident management experience using JIRA and ServiceNow.
* Collaborate with developers to streamline code deployments and environment configurations.
* Work with multiple teams to implement security best practices across Containers, EC2 and Serverless workloads. Embed security guardrails into CI/CD pipelines including SAST, SCA, DAST, container image scanning and SBOM generation, with policy-based gating and fail-fast controls.
* Build and secure container platforms on EKS or ECS, including image hardening, admission controls, runtime security and patching cadence.
* Participate in on-call rotation, incident response, blameless post-mortems and periodic disaster recovery and resilience testing.
* Implement anomaly detection, event correlation and alert noise reduction across metrics, logs and traces to reduce alert fatigue and improve MTTD/MTTR. Build auto-remediation and self-healing workflows triggered by observability signals using EventBridge, Lambda, Step Functions and SSM Automation. Leverage ML and GenAI capabilities, such as Amazon Bedrock and agentic or MCP-based tooling, for intelligent triage, root cause analysis assistance and operational knowledge retrieval.
* Design and implement AIOps solutions to monitor, analyze, and optimize AWS cloud infrastructure and costs.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with core AWS services including EC2, ASG, Security Groups, ALB/NLB/WAF, NACLs, Routing, Route 53, VPC networking, EC2 Image Builder, EKS, ECS, ECR, Lambda and SSM.
* Experience in setting up, securing and operating Kubernetes clusters across cloud and hybrid platforms, including upgrades, scaling and troubleshooting.
* Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration on EKS and ECS, covering image hardening, registry management and runtime security.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code using reusable Terraform modules, remote state management, drift detection and automated plan/apply workflows.
* Experience working with AWS Bedrock foundation models and SageMaker Studio, including prompt design, model selection and cost-aware inference.
* Experience integrating AIOps tooling with AWS services such as CloudWatch, EventBridge, Lambda, S3, EC2, ECS and RDS to enable automated detection and response.
* Hands on Experience on testing and orchestrating Disaster Recovery Strategies on AWS cloud.
* Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines using Harness, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, including job promotion, approvals and rollback strategies.
* Practical experience with application and infrastructure security tooling covering SAST, SCA, DAST, container image scanning and SBOM generation using tools such as SonarQube, JFrog Xray, checkamrx and Wiz.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash or powershell with strong Git and branching-strategy discipline.
* Hands-on experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, CloudWatch, Dynatrace or OpenTelemetry, covering metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring and dashboarding.
* Experience building auto-remediation and self-healing workflows using EventBridge, Lambda, Step Functions and SSM Automation.
* Exposure to agentic and GenAI-assisted operations, including Bedrock AgentCore, MCP-based tooling, RAG patterns and AI-assisted triage or root cause analysis.
* FinOps and cost optimisation experience covering tagging governance, rightsizing, Graviton migration, Spot adoption, Savings Plans coverage and cost anomaly detection.
* Experience with incident, problem and change management using JIRA and ServiceNow, including on-call participation, post-incident reviews and DR/resilience testing.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and mentoring skills, with the ability to lead technical initiatives independently in an Agile environment.

title: Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Manager, Cloud Infrastructure is a hands-on leader responsible for the reliability, resilience, performance, operational discipline, cost management, and continuous improvement of Nationwide’s cloud infrastructure and AI platform capabilities in India. This role leads cloud infrastructure and AI platform engineering work while partnering closely with Core Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Application, Data, and business teams.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong cloud and infrastructure judgment with an optimistic, people-centered leadership style. They will be visible in the work, comfortable engaging at both strategic and technical levels, and passionate about developing, coaching, and recognizing people so the organization builds durable cloud capability for the future.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day delivery and operational performance across cloud infrastructure and AI platform capabilities.
* Liaise and coordinate with Nationwide US leadership team and frontline staff.
* Establish clear priorities, service expectations, ownership models, and escalation paths across participating teams.
* Maintain a strong focus on availability, resilience, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, and compliance.
* Provide hands-on leadership during complex cloud incidents, problem investigations, major changes, migrations, and service-improvement initiatives.
* Drive standardization, automation, infrastructure as code, platform enablement, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational toil.
* Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to shape practical, scalable cloud road maps and adoption patterns.
* Build disciplined practices for monitoring, observability, configuration management, patching, vulnerability remediation, disaster recovery, landing-zone governance, and technical debt reduction.
* Strengthen FinOps practices by improving cloud cost transparency, forecasting, demand management, utilization, tagging, chargeback or showback, and accountability across cloud services.
* Promote secure-by-default, resilient-by-design, and repeatable cloud engineering patterns.
* Coordinate dependencies across Cloud, Core Infrastructure, Security, Network, Data, Applications, and enterprise architecture to deliver integrated outcomes.
* Develop trusted relationships with internal partners, cloud providers, vendors, and service providers.
* Translate business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, risks, and decisions for senior leadership.
* Ensure cloud processes and technical solutions support Nationwide’s risk-management, governance, and audit expectations.

**People leadership expectations**

* Create a positive, inclusive, and accountable team environment.
* Coach individuals through regular feedback, career conversations, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities.
* Build a strong bench of cloud and platform talent through delegation, stretch assignments, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Recognize contributions and reinforce behaviors that improve customer outcomes, teamwork, and reliability.
* Lead through change with transparency, empathy, consistency, and a bias toward constructive problem solving.
* Encourage healthy challenge, learning from incidents, and continuous improvement without blame.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Significant experience leading cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or cloud operations teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience designing, operating, or modernizing cloud infrastructure and platform services at enterprise scale.
* Experience leading critical incidents, operational reviews, service improvements, migrations, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong understanding of cloud reliability, security, resilience, capacity, performance, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals and first-line leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues to senior and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with distributed teams, external partners, and global operating models.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated, highly available, or financial-services environment.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, containers, platform engineering, observability, DevSecOps, and modern operational practices.
* Experience with cloud landing zones, identity and access management, network architecture, resiliency patterns, and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, cloud-provider relationships, service providers, and technology road maps.
* Experience establishing or improving FinOps, IT service management, or reliability engineering practices.

**Leadership profile**
We are seeking a leader who is technically credible, calm under pressure, optimistic, collaborative, and committed to making the people and the platform better every day. The right candidate brings energy to difficult problems, stays close enough to the work to understand reality, and creates an environment where people can do their best work.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technological solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
The Technology Engineering Manager manages a team of infrastructure engineers who analyse, design, develop and implement hardware/software. You’ll determine hardware/software systems requirements; lead systems hardware/software design; plan projects; and establish priorities. You’ll also coordinate with other managers to integrate projects with other systems hardware/software. As a people leader, you have responsibility for project deployment, career development, performance management and pay determination. You also may have the opportunity to mentor associates on other teams.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manages a team that delivers on build and operational components for the product(s) aligned to a technology area, such as but not limited to, consulting, managing and development of new products, upgrade/patching efforts, annual budgeting, efficiency efforts, etc. and the function responsible for driving a competitive unit cost through efficient product lifecycle.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Leads a team accountable for product delivery and the first line of defense for risk and security management.
* Assigns and allocates roles, in partnership with the Technology Product Executive, based on capacity and demand (finance, marketing, etc.).
* Responsible for the design, development, modification and implementation of products and processes to aid in the overall product lifecycle and operational metrics.
* Manages a team who is accountable for product management across platforms (on-premises, off-premises and across premises) by providing engineering support for products/processes to improve productivity and reduce cost.
* Demonstrates user empathy by partnering with user advocates to understand and incorporate user sentiment.
* Understands and manages team skill maturity in context of effective product management.
* Oversee vendor management/relationships and sourcing, in collaboration with Technology Product Manager.
* Drives release cadence and business feature alignment leveraging automation to drive speed and actively drives continuous process improvement activities including Lean, process/product innovation, quality, cost reduction and other initiatives.
* Leads people through guidance and support on the execution of work; management of associates including but not limited to performance management, salary planning, training, development, workforce planning, hiring, and disciplinary actions; and attracts, hires, engages and develops the team through impactful recruitment, coaching and feedback.
* Participates in strategic initiatives/planning for core products including products that cross Technologies.
* Develops and manages project budgets and deployment, including training and development of personnel.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, mathematics, or related field is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Eight years knowledge of operational management concepts and techniques. Experience leading multiple teams and assets across various technology platforms. Three years of management experience is preferred. Experience with concepts and solutions: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and package solutions.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Business Strategies
* Computer Science
* Financial Management
* IT Infrastructure
* Technical Acumen
* Vendor Management
* Technology Strategies

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication skills
* Ability to influence, negotiate, and set priorities
* Mentoring and coaching abilities to guide associates
* Identifying and removing blockers to progress
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus
* Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence

**Additional Information**
**Reporting Structure:**
Reports to Technology Executive – India
  
  
**Working Hours**
Aligned to India business hours with flexibility for global collaboration.
  
  
**Location Flexibility:**
[Hybrid/Remote/In-office] with periodic in-office collaboration.

Nationwide is committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, disability, religion, or other protected categories.

title: Technical Lead / Engineering Lead – Hands-On
description:
**Technical Lead / Engineering Lead – Hands-On**

**Company: Template.net**

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**About Template.net**

Template.net is an AI-native creation platform used by more than 4 million people worldwide every month.

We are building the next generation of AI-powered creation tools, where users simply describe what they need, and AI turns their ideas into finished, editable designs, videos, and documents—all in one place, from prompt to ready-to-use content in minutes.

We are a global product and technology company building scalable, high-performance AI products for users worldwide.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead / Engineering Lead who can own engineering end-to-end—from system architecture and writing production code to deployment, scaling, and production reliability.

This is not a management-only role. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys coding, solving complex technical challenges, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building high-performing engineering teams.

You'll work closely with Product to build, launch, and scale AI-powered applications used by millions of people worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end engineering: Lead system architecture, technical design, development, deployment, scaling, and production operations.
* Stay hands-on with coding: Actively write, review, debug, and ship production code while guiding the engineering team.
* Design scalable systems: Build reliable, high-performance applications using modern backend architectures, databases, APIs, caching, queues, and asynchronous processing.
* Build AI-powered products: Integrate LLMs, generative AI models, APIs, and image, video, and audio generation workflows.
* Optimize AI infrastructure: Improve inference latency, processing performance, model integration reliability, and API costs.
* Own production reliability: Drive CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, security, performance optimization, and incident resolution.
* Accelerate engineering delivery: Leverage AI-assisted coding tools, automation, and modern development practices to ship high-quality software faster.
* Build and mentor the team: Hire, develop, and lead engineers while establishing strong engineering standards and a culture of ownership.
* Ship products quickly: Collaborate closely with Product to turn ideas into working software, launch features rapidly, and continuously improve them.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with proven hands-on coding skills and technical leadership.
* Engineer first, leader second: Someone who enjoys writing code, solving complex technical problems, and leading by example—not just managing people.
* Strong backend or full-stack expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, SQL, or comparable technologies.
* Deep understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and scalable application design.
* End-to-end product engineering experience: Proven ability to independently design, build, deploy, scale, and troubleshoot production applications.
* Practical AI/GenAI experience: Experience integrating LLM APIs and building AI-powered applications. Exposure to image, video, or audio generation is an advantage.
* Strong production engineering skills in performance optimization, security, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and reliability.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, making architectural decisions, and building high-performing teams.
* AI-first development mindset: Comfortable using AI coding tools, automation, and modern engineering workflows to accelerate development.
* Strong ownership and product thinking: Able to make pragmatic technical decisions, move quickly, avoid unnecessary complexity, and deliver reliable products that create real customer value.

**Why Join Template.net?**

* Build cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide.
* Work on challenging engineering problems across generative AI, image, video, documents, and design.
* Take real ownership of technical architecture, engineering decisions, and product delivery.
* Build and lead a talented engineering team while continuing to write production code.
* Work in a fast-moving, product-focused environment where your contributions have a direct impact.

* We're looking for a builder who leads by example—someone who can take a problem, design the solution, write the code, ship it to production

title: Senior Network Site Reliability Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Network Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Enterprise Network Operations and SRE team. In this role, you will be pivotal in implementing our vision for a reliable and efficient network infrastructure.
  
  
The ideal candidate is passionate about network operations and committed to enhancing the user experience. You'll have the opportunity to solve complex network challenges using hands-on debugging and by focusing on network automation, observability, documentation, and operational excellence. This is a critical position focused on ensuring user satisfaction and brilliance in network operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Owning the operational aspect of the network infrastructure, ensuring its high availability and reliability, actively working on network incidents and service requests.
* Partnering with architecture and deployment teams to guarantee that new implementations are supportable and align with production standards.
* Advocating for and implementing automation to reduce toil and improve operational efficiency. Minimizing manual operational tasks to achieve and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Monitoring network performance, identifying areas for improvement, and collaborating with relevant teams to implement refinements. Proactively identifying and mitigating network risks to promote continuous improvement.
* Collaborating with domain experts across functions to resolve production issues swiftly and effectively, ensuring customer happiness.
* Conducting blameless postmortems and following through on Root Cause Analyses (RCAs).
* Discovering opportunities for operational improvements and teaming up with colleagues to devise solutions that enhance excellence and sustainability in network operations.
* Developing knowledge base articles for automation and bots.

**What We Need To See**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Work Background: A minimum of 10 years of industry practice in network operations or related fields concentrating on support, automation & site reliability engineering. Familiarity with both enterprise and the data center networks is critical.
* Strong proficiency in network fundamentals & fixing complex network issues with expertise in network tech like TCP/UDP, IPv4/IPv6, BGP, OSPF, ISIS, VPN, L2 switching, Firewalls, Load Balancers, Data Center Network technologies, Wireless etc. Consistent track record in network operations.
* Monitoring Tools: Familiarity with network management tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Alert Manager, Nautobot/Netbox, BigPanda.
* Network Automation: Experience in automating networks using frameworks such as Salt, Ansible, Python or similar.
* Process & Service Tooling: Skills with ServiceNow, Jira & foundational knowledge of ITIL framework
* System Administration: Knowledge of Linux system fundamentals.
* Problem-Solving and Communication: Detailed problem-solving approach, critical thinking, coupled with good interpersonal skills and a solid grasp of ownership and drive.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Support Automation: Track record of taking operational signals through means such as SNMP, Syslog, Streaming Telemetry to solve operational challenges.
* Platform Exposure: Experience with Mellanox/Cumulus Linux, Cisco/ Arista, Palo Alto firewalls, Versa SDWAN, Netscalers and F5 load balancers.
* Technical Proficiency in Programming and Scripting: Competence in Python, Go, or related programming languages. Skilled in constructing intricate systems to supervise and regulate network operations, surpassing elementary script development.
* Network Technologies: Proficient knowledge of one or more of the following technologies: VXLAN/EVPN at Scale, MPLS, RSVP, Segment Routing, SDWAN, SASE Platforms

title: DEVOPS TECHNICAL LEAD - Azure DevOps
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on DevOps CI/CD Engineer to own the implementation, administration, optimization, and governance of our enterprise GitHub and CI/CD ecosystem. This is a technical ownership and engineering role ? not a traditional support position. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining scalable CI/CD workflows, establishing enterprise GitHub standards, troubleshooting complex pipeline issues, and driving adoption of modern DevOps and DevSecOps practices across engineering teams.
  
  
You will work closely with development, QA, operations, security, architecture, and cloud engineering teams to build reliable, secure, and highly automated software delivery processes. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Git, Docker, Azure, AWS and AKS, combined with strong troubleshooting, automation, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  
  
Team & Key Projects
  
  

* Team
* Purpose of this team/Key Projects
* Reason for the Posting
* Motivators for this need

**OwnerSHIP:**
You treat GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD as a platform that you own and continuously improve ? not simply a tool that you operate.
  
  
**Problem Solver:**
You can independently investigate complex pipeline failures, identify root causes, and implement permanent solutions.
  
  
**Automation Mindset:**
You look for opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual work through scripting, workflow automation, and reusable pipeline components.
  
  
**Quality Focused:**
You understand that successful CI/CD is not simply about getting a pipeline to pass. Reliability, security, testing, compliance, and measurable delivery outcomes matter.
  
  
**Self-Directed:**
You can work independently, prioritize competing technical issues, and deliver outcomes without continuous supervision.
  
  
**Collaborative:**
You work effectively with developers, QA engineers, architects, security teams, cloud engineers, and operations teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
You proactively identify opportunities to improve pipeline performance, developer experience, platform reliability, security, and engineering KPIs.
  
  
**Technical Communicator:**
You can explain complex CI/CD and GitHub concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and create documentation that teams can actually use.
  
  
Typical Day in the Role
  
  

* Day-to-day roles and responsibilities
* Interaction level with team
* Work environment description
* GitHub Enterprise Platform Administration
* Own the administration, configuration, and optimization of the enterprise GitHub environment.
* Configure and manage GitHub organizations, repositories, teams, permissions, policies, and enterprise-level settings.
* Establish and enforce repository governance standards including branch protection, pull request policies, CODEOWNERS, required status checks, and review requirements.
* Manage GitHub Enterprise integrations with CI/CD, security, cloud, testing, and deployment platforms.
* Configure and maintain GitHub Actions runners, including GitHub-hosted and self-hosted runner environments.
* Troubleshoot GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions issues across repositories, workflows, permissions, runners, integrations, and authentication.
* Support enterprise adoption and standardization of GitHub across development teams.
* CI/CD Pipeline Development & Engineering
* Design, develop, implement, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
* Build reusable and maintainable workflow and pipeline templates that can be adopted across multiple engineering teams.
* Automate end-to-end build, test, security scanning, artifact creation, and deployment processes.
* Implement multi-stage CI/CD workflows covering development, testing, quality validation, approvals, and production deployment.
* Integrate CI/CD pipelines with source control, testing frameworks, artifact repositories, security scanners, cloud platforms, and deployment tools.
* Implement pipeline automation that supports reliable and repeatable software delivery across environments.
* Develop appropriate branching, pull request, merge, and release strategies aligned with enterprise DevOps standards.
* Pipeline Troubleshooting & Performance Optimization
* Act as a technical escalation point for complex CI/CD pipeline failures and deployment issues.
* Diagnose and resolve failures involving YAML configuration, authentication, permissions, runners/agents, dependencies, build tools, deployments, and integrations.
* Analyze pipeline execution time and identify opportunities to improve build and deployment performance.
* Optimize caching, parallel execution, dependencies, artifact handling, and runner utilization.
* Investigate intermittent and environment-specific pipeline failures and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Establish troubleshooting standards, reusable diagnostics, and operational runbooks for common CI/CD issues.
* Azure & AWS Cloud, Docker & Kubernetes Engineering
* Design and maintain CI/CD processes supporting cloud-native applications deployed on Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Build and maintain Docker-based application build and deployment workflows.
* Integrate container image build, scanning, tagging, and publishing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support deployments to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) using appropriate deployment methodologies.
* Work with Kubernetes deployment mechanisms including Helm, kubectl, manifests, and related automation.
* Integrate pipelines with Azure and AWS services and cloud-native deployment architectures.
* Troubleshoot container build, registry, Kubernetes deployment, and application rollout issues.
* Collaborate with Azure and AWS architects and engineering teams to improve cloud deployment reliability, scalability, and automation.
* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and integrating AWS deployments into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with AWS services such as EKS, ECR, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and related deployment and monitoring services.
* Build and maintain containerized application deployment workflows using AWS EKS and ECR.
* Implement secure authentication and access management for AWS-based CI/CD integrations using IAM roles and federated identity where applicable.
* DevSecOps & Security Integration
* Implement security best practices throughout the CI/CD lifecycle.
* Integrate security scanning and quality controls into CI/CD workflows.
* Support implementation of SAST, dependency scanning, container vulnerability scanning, and other DevSecOps controls.
* Implement secure management of credentials, secrets, service connections, and pipeline variables.
* Apply least-privilege principles to GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, and CI/CD integrations.
* Support regular security assessments, vulnerability remediation, and CI/CD platform audits.
* Ensure CI/CD processes comply with organizational security, governance, and regulatory requirements.
* DevSecOps Metrics & KPI Improvement
* Support initiatives focused on improving engineering and software delivery KPIs.
* Establish and improve visibility into DevSecOps metrics including Change Failure Rate, Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), Regression Testing Effectiveness, Escaped / Escape Defects, Pipeline Success Rate, Build and Deployment Duration, and Security Vulnerability Trends.
* Analyze CI/CD performance and identify opportunities for measurable improvement.
* Partner with engineering and QA teams to reduce failed deployments, regression defects, and production escapes.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to improve software delivery quality and reliability.
* Testing & Quality Engineering
* Implement end-to-end testing within CI/CD pipelines.
* Integrate unit, integration, regression, API, security, and deployment validation testing as appropriate.
* Configure automated quality gates to prevent defective or non-compliant code from progressing through the delivery lifecycle.
* Integrate pipeline execution with test reporting and quality management frameworks.
* Troubleshoot test execution failures and identify whether failures originate from code, infrastructure, dependencies, configuration, or pipeline implementation.
* Continuously improve automated testing coverage and reliability within CI/CD workflows.
* Automation & Scripting
* Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting technologies.
* Automate repetitive administrative, deployment, validation, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities.
* Build reusable scripts and utilities that improve developer productivity and platform efficiency.
* Integrate scripting and automation into GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps workflows.
* Maintain clean, documented, secure, and supportable automation code.
* Collaboration, Technical Guidance & Leadership
* Work closely with development, QA, operations, security, architecture, and cloud engineering teams.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring on GitHub, Git, CI/CD, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices.
* Act as a subject matter expert for GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD engineering.
* Drive adoption of standardized CI/CD practices across engineering teams.
* Lead technical discussions around branching strategies, pipeline architecture, automation, security, and deployment practices.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize engineering processes.
* Promote knowledge sharing and establish reusable patterns and best practices.
* Documentation & Operational Excellence
* Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation for GitHub Enterprise and CI/CD processes.
* Develop architecture documentation, pipeline standards, troubleshooting guides, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Document GitHub governance, branching strategies, security controls, and CI/CD best practices.
* Maintain accurate documentation of integrations, configurations, dependencies, and operational processes.
* Ensure lessons learned from incidents and recurring pipeline failures are incorporated into platform improvements.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and service to ensure reliability and functionality. Forecasts demands and responds to capacity needs. Collaborates with software development teams to develop reliable and scalable infrastructures. Performs data collection to maintain and optimize operations and reliability. Leverages knowledge to perform incident response and/or maintenance tasks. Provides health and performance reporting. Identifies opportunities for automation. Communicates about services and identifies and explains the potential impact of changes. Provides support for technology and documents incidents. Experiments with new tools and assesses potential impact and develops knowledge of site reliability trends.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Capacity Ingestion and Management:**

* Takes proactive steps to design and architect infrastructure and/or service according to terms for reliability and functionality.
* Forecasts demands for infrastructure and responds to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads.
* Collaborates with the software development team to develop infrastructures and features that are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements.
* Independently identifies opportunities for and drives prototyping (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding).

**Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:**

* Performs data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection to maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability.
* Independently monitors services, maintains up-to-date knowledge of their performance, and documents their condition.
* Leverages comprehensive knowledge to perform incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery).
* Provides health and performance reporting and takes appropriate actions based on trends in data.
* May independently perform provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services.
* May perform standard and non-standard decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed.

**Automation:**

* Identifies opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits.
* Develops automation tools or scripts to provide solutions, gather metrics, monitor, analyze, mitigate, or remediate issues/defects within infrastructures.
* Independently conducts testing to ensure automation performs the task correctly and produces expected results.

Technical Communication and Guidance:
  
  

* Communicates the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology within and sometimes beyond immediate team.
* Identifies and explains the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact on team operations.

**Troubleshooting and Resolution:**

* Provides operational support for technology, escalating incidents and other standard and non-standard issues arising within Oracle services.
* Participates in on-call shifts to address issues.
* Resolves technical issues spanning various services, investigating and debugging products in order to reach SLOs (service level objectives).
* Documents incidents and performs root cause analyses according to standard reporting methods.
* Independently performs post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence.

**Innovation and Improvement:**

* Experiments with new tools and technologies to assess their potential impact on and improve infrastructure performance and reliability, ensuring adherence to security standards.
* Independently identifies and executes improvements for performance bottlenecks and deployments to ensure efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability.
* Develops knowledge of site reliability trends and shares new information with team members, management, and beyond to help others build, test, deploy and run services.
* Performs standard and non-standard analyses and provides clear data on production to contribute to business development decisions (e.g., design changes).

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**
Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.
  
  
**Collaboration & Partnership:**
Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
  
  
**Problem Solving:**
Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.
  
  
**Continuous Learning:**
Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Sr Manager, Software Development & Engineering

* Deep understanding of incident life cycle and strong background in incident and problem manage
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical issues, risks, workarounds, and resolution plans to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to participate in rotational on-call support, respond to production incidents, and drive timely restoration of service while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.
* Experience working in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably financial services, with a focus on secure, compliant, and reliable technology operations.

**Preffered Skills**
A commitment to high ethical standards and integrity, demonstrated through action.
  
  
High-energy, positive, entrepreneurial in spirit.
  
  
Purposeful and results driven.
  
  
Well-organized and disciplined with high mindfulness.
  
  
Direct, plain-spoken; conveys a genuine and authentic demeanor.
  
  
Considerable experience transforming teams through technology, organization, culture, process, and business change management.

What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Nomiso is scaling an on-premise Agentic AI Platform from proof-of-value into enterprise production for tier-1 telecom operator. As a Devops Engineer, You will own the foundation that powers self-hosted LLM endpoint (vLLM), Kubernetes infrastructure, and automated GitOps Pipelines within a secure client environment.

**What you will do**

* Build and operate the Kubernetes platform on Linux VMs inside the client network: cluster setup, upgrades, networking, storage and node management.
* Own the CI/CD pipelines: Docker image builds, security scanning, Helm packaging and GitOps deployment through ArgoCD across dev, staging and production.
* Manage environments as code with Terraform or Ansible, including Linux hardening, patching and configuration drift control.
* Run the data and messaging layer the application depends on: SQL Server connectivity, Redis, Kafka and object storage, working with the client DBA team where they own the service.
* Deploy and operate the self hosted LLM serving stack (vLLM or an OpenAI compatible gateway)
* and ML tooling such as MLflow, including GPU node scheduling where available.
* Set up observability end to end: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki and OpenTelemetry tracing per ticket,
* with alerts routed to Teams and the client ops tooling.
* Manage secrets, certificates and service identities through Vault and Active Directory, and keep the platform aligned with client security and VPN access controls.
* Define SLOs, run capacity and latency reviews for the integration path (LLM endpoint, ACS, NMS, inventory APIs) and tune resources to keep per ticket decisions within the agreed window.
* Write runbooks, handle incidents, lead root cause reviews and train client operations staff ahead of handover.

**What you bring**

* 4 to 5 years in DevOps or platform engineering, with strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu or similar): systemd, networking, storage, performance troubleshooting.
* Production Kubernetes experience: Helm, ingress, RBAC, persistent volumes, resource limits, cluster upgrades.
* Docker and container security basics, including image scanning and non root builds.
* CI/CD with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Azure DevOps, and GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform and configuration management with Ansible.
* Scripting in Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
* Observability stack experience: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or ELK, OpenTelemetry.
* Comfortable in an on premise environment with VPN access, firewalls, proxies and Windows Active Directory integration.
* Clear written communication: runbooks, change notes and incident summaries that client teams can follow.

**Good to have**

* Running LLM or ML workloads on Kubernetes: vLLM, GPU scheduling, MLflow, model serving.
* Exposure to SQL Server, Redis and Kafka operations.
* Rancher, Azure Stack HCI or other on premise Kubernetes distributions.
* HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk, certificate automation.
* Telecom or large enterprise client delivery experience.
* Certifications such as CKA, RHCSA or Terraform Associate.

**How we work**

Small team, direct access to the technical lead, measured delivery in phases with the client. You will be the single owner of the platform, so judgement, documentation and calm incident handling matter as much as tool knowledge.

Hybrid working from Bengaluru or Hyderabad, with no travel required.
