title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Site Reliability Engineer

**About AssetMark:**

AssetMark is a leading strategic provider of innovative investment and consulting solutions serving independent financial advisors. We provide investment, relationship, and practice management solutions that advisors use in helping clients achieve wealth, independence, and purpose.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our engineering team. This role sits at the center of platform resilience — ensuring high availability, performance, recoverability, and operational maturity across AssetMark’s production systems.

This is not a traditional operations role. Our SREs are engineers first: designing automation, building observability frameworks, improving deployment safety, defining reliability standards, and reducing operational toil through code. You will influence architectural decisions, strengthen incident management practices, and raise the reliability bar across both legacy and cloud-native systems.

You will work on systems that operate 24/7, support financial transactions and advisor workflows, and must meet strict regulatory and security requirements. The right candidate is energized by complex distributed systems, high-stakes production environments, and the responsibility of building durable, scalable financial infrastructure.

At AssetMark, reliability is a first-order expression of client obsession. Our SRE team plays a critical role in delivering the consistent, trusted technology experience that advisors depend on to run their businesses.

Key Responsibilities

**Reliability Engineering & Operations**

* Design, implement, and continuously improve the reliability, availability, and performance of critical AssetMark systems (batch, APIs, integrations, and customer-facing platforms)
* Define and operationalize SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services in partnership with engineering and product teams
* Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and major incident management
* Lead and contribute to blameless post-incident reviews, driving root cause analysis and measurable reliability improvements
* Proactively identify reliability risks and lead remediation efforts before they impact clients

**Observability & Monitoring**

* Build and maintain end-to-end observability across applications, infrastructure, and integrations (metrics, logs, traces, alerts)
* Implement actionable monitoring and alerting to reduce noise and improve signal quality
* Partner with application teams to instrument services using best-in-class observability practices
* Ensure visibility into system health, capacity, performance, and failure modes across environments
* Hands-on experience with Grafana, Azure Log Analytics, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or equivalents.

**Automation & Toil Reduction**

* Identify repetitive operational tasks and automate them through code
* Improve deployment reliability through automation, self-service tooling, and safe rollout patterns
* Reduce manual intervention in batch processing, integrations, and operational workflows
* Apply Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration automation to improve consistency and repeatability

**Cloud, Platform & Infrastructure Reliability**

* Support reliability of Azure-based infrastructure, containerized workloads, and hybrid environments
* Partner with platform, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to improve resilience, scalability, and recovery
* Contribute to capacity planning, performance tuning, and cost-aware reliability decisions
* Ensure systems meet RTO/RPO, backup, and disaster recovery expectations

**Secure & Compliant Operations**

* Embed security, compliance, and risk controls into operational practices
* Work closely with Security and Compliance teams to meet financial services regulatory requirements
* Ensure production systems follow least privilege, secure configuration, and auditability standards
* Support vulnerability remediation and secure operational processes
* Deep understanding of environment reliability and stability engineering needs in High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Capacity Planning, Performance Engineering, Disaster Recovery, Multi-Region Architecture, Scalability, and Chaos Engineering

**Collaboration & Enablement**

* Partner with application engineering teams to improve production readiness and operational maturity
* Influence system design by advocating for reliability-first architectural decisions
* Provide guidance on operational best practices, deployment safety, and observability standards
* Document operational patterns, runbooks, and reliability guidelines in Confluence
* Act as a reliability advocate across AssetMark engineering teams

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

* Strong software engineering skills in .NET / C#, Python, Java, NodeJS, or similar
* Experience operating distributed systems in production
* Deep understanding of SRE principles: SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction, incident management
* Experience with Azure (or AWS/GCP), including compute, networking, and managed services
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes preferred)
* Experience with monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting tools
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and Infrastructure-as-Code
* Deep understanding of system administration, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, SSL / TLS), Storage, Load Balancing, and File Systems
* Understanding of security best practices in regulated enterprise environments
* Experience with JIRA, PagerDuty, or equivalent
* Experience supporting financial services or highly regulated systems (preferred)

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
* 5-8 years of software engineering experience of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or production operations
* Proven experience in troubleshooting and improving production system reliability
* Experience supporting 24/7 systems, batch processing, and mission-critical workloads
* Strong collaboration skills across engineering, security, and infrastructure teams
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
* Experience building APIs, services, and/or platform components
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, and large-scale system design
* Experience with DevOps practices, cross-functional collaboration, and agile/scrum development methodologies

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title - DevOps Engineer**

**Location - ADB SAFEGATE Labs India, Hyderabad**

**Full time role**

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid (4 days from office)

**Who Are We?**

ADB SAFEGATE is the market leader in Airfield Solutions, with a presence in 2,700 airports and 40 offices worldwide. We are building ADB SAFEGATE Labs India in Hyderabad – our latest software development hub. This is an opportunity to join a truly global company, working on innovative software solutions that support airport operations across Airfield, Apron, Terminal, Tower, and Weather solutions.

Our mission: helping airports achieve new levels of safety, sustainability, and efficiency in airside operations. If you’re passionate about developing innovative products and solutions that make air travel safer and better, come join our crew!

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a software engineer with strong leadership skills who can take ownership of DevOps responsibilities and drive a service-oriented architecture mindset across the team. You will design, build, and operate a container-based delivery platform (artifacts shipped as containers) and maintain reliable development and runtime environments across both virtualized (e.g., Azure VMware Solution) and physical server landscapes. You will champion engineering quality (clean code, testing, automated analysis), operational excellence (troubleshooting, observability), and security compliance (CIS hardening, CVE reporting).

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical leadership & collaboration**
* Lead by example in engineering practices, mentoring team members and driving pragmatic standards.
* Collaborate with developers, platform/infrastructure, and security stakeholders to deliver efficient, reliable solutions in a small team environment.

* **DevOps & CI/CD (container-centric)**
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines where
  **deliverables are container images**
  , including versioning, promotion strategies, and traceability.
* Automate build, test, security checks, and deployment workflows; ensure repeatable environment provisioning.
* Integrate artifact/image registries, policy enforcement, and automated reporting.

* **Containerization & orchestration**
* Design and maintain container build patterns (base images, hardening, minimal images, SBOM where applicable).
* Operate and support container orchestration platforms,
  **including Kubernetes**
  , while also handling container runtime aspects beyond orchestration.

* **Service-oriented architecture enablement**
* Support teams in designing, deploying, and operating service-oriented/microservice-style systems (interfaces, contracts, runtime concerns).
* Enable platform capabilities for service reliability (health checks, rolling updates, scaling, dependency management).

* **Infrastructure & OS platform engineering (Physical, Virtual, Managed)**
* Provide and maintain tailored operating system baselines for:
* **RHEL and Windows**
* Virtual environments (e.g.,
  **Azure, VMware Solution**
  ) and physical servers
* Automate provisioning, configuration, patching, and lifecycle management using Ansible and Terraform (for cloud infrastructure).

* **Quality engineering & reliability**
* Drive code quality practices:
  **Clean Code**
  , code reviews, static analysis, linting, formatting, and dependency hygiene.
* Ensure automated testing strategy coverage (integration/system), pipeline gating, and reproducible environments.
* Own troubleshooting across the stack (pipelines, containers, OS, network, runtime issues) and improve operability via metrics/logging/tracing.

* **Security & compliance proof**
* Implement and document security controls, including
  **CIS hardening**
  for OS and container images.
* Provide
  **CVE reporting**
  , vulnerability remediation workflows, and evidence suitable for audits (e.g., baselines, reports, exceptions).

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4-5 years of experience in DevOps role.
* Proven experience with ownership, mentoring, decision-making.
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **containerization**
  (Docker/OCI), image build optimization, and secure image practices.
* Solid experience with
  **CI/CD**
  design and operations (pipelines, gating, promotions, automation).
* Practical expertise with
  **Kubernetes**
  and container operations concepts (deployments, config, secrets, networking basics).
* Strong
  **Python**
  skills for automation/tools and
  **Ansible**
  for configuration management and OS provisioning.
* Experience administering and hardening
  **RHEL**
  and
  **Windows**
  (golden images/baselines, patching, configuration).
* Ability to work effectively in a
  **small, efficiency-focused team**
  with end-to-end responsibility.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Experience with Azure and/or
  **Azure VMware Solution**
  operations and integration patterns.
* Experience generating/maintaining
  **SBOMs**
  , signing images, and supply chain security (e.g., provenance/attestation).
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code beyond Ansible (e.g., Terraform) and secrets management solutions.
* Experience with Rancher tools such as RKE2, and K3s for Kubernetes management and orchestration.
* Experience with Grafana and Prometheus for observability, monitoring, and alerting.

**What Success Looks Like (Outcomes)**

* A reliable, fast, and secure container-based CI/CD process with clear promotion paths and traceability.
* Standardized, hardened, and maintainable RHEL/Windows baselines for both virtual and physical environments.
* Measurable improvements in code quality, test automation, and operational stability.
* Repeatable security evidence: CIS compliance status, CVE posture, remediation tracking, and audit-ready documentation.

title: Site Reliability Engineer II
description:
**About the Company**

NationsBenefits is at the forefront of transforming the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We specialize in modernizing complex back-office systems to build scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. Our strategic focus is on platform modernization, transitioning legacy systems into modern, cloudnative architectures to enhance scalability, reliability, and performance in core back-office insurance and fintech functions.

**About the Role**

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team is instrumental in maintaining the health, performance, and availability of our platforms. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring system reliability by monitoring metrics, managing incidents, and collaborating with Development, DevSecOps, and Engineering teams. You will work with monitoring tools like Datadog, troubleshoot incidents in Kubernetes and cloud environments, and contribute to automation initiatives using C#, Java, or scripting languages. Your focus will be on maintaining high availability, ensuring security and compliance in fintech environments, and driving continuous service improvement.

**Responsibilities**

***Incident Triage & Resolution***

* Act as the first line of defense in identifying, triaging, and resolving production incidents.
* Respond to and troubleshoot alerts from monitoring tools such as Datadog.
* Perform initial root cause analysis and escalate per service level agreements (SLAs).
* Collaborate with senior engineers to resolve escalated issues and provide timely communication to stakeholders.

***Monitoring & Alerting***

* Proactively monitor system health, performance metrics, and service uptime using Datadog.
* Manage and optimize alerting thresholds to detect anomalies while reducing false positives.
* Monitor and troubleshoot workloads in Kubernetes, including pod restarts, log analysis, and deployment rollbacks.

***24/7 Support***

* Participate in a rotational shift schedule (24/7), including weekends and holidays, to ensure continuous production support.

***Collaboration & Communication***

* Work closely with development, operations, and engineering teams to diagnose and resolve issues.
* Provide feedback on recurring issues and recommend process or tooling improvements.
* Partner with global teams, demonstrating strong cross-cultural collaboration skills.

***Automation & Continuous Improvement***

* Develop and maintain automation scripts or small tools using C#, Java, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipeline monitoring and reliability.
* Assist in building self-healing and automated recovery solutions to minimize manual intervention.

***Documentation & Compliance***

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of incidents, triage steps, and post-mortem analysis.
* Ensure all processes adhere to fintech compliance standards such as PCI DSS or ISO 27001.

**Required Skills**

* 4-6 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or a related role.
* Experience with incident triage, resolution, and escalation processes.
* Proficiency with Datadog or similar monitoring/observability tools.
* Strong scripting or programming skills in C#, Java, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Experience with Kubernetes (monitoring, troubleshooting, scaling workloads) and containerized environments like Docker.
* Familiarity with SQL, MySQL, or NoSQL databases.
* Ability to work effectively in high-pressure, high-transaction fintech environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work in rotational 24/7 shifts, including weekends and holidays.

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Helm charts, and deployment automation.
* Awareness of ITIL processes and agile methodologies.
* Understanding of regulatory and security compliance requirements in fintech (e.g., PCI DSS, ISO 27001).

If you are passionate about ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of production systems, and you have experience with Kubernetes, Datadog, and automation, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Engineer

With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. The Teradata culture is built on diversity, collaboration, and innovation. Individuals with different backgrounds and perspectives come together with a shared goal of making Teradata and our people the best we can be.
  
  
**Our Team**

* This position is for a Senior Software Engineer in the Platform Services team within the Vantage Core Platform Software organization.
* The team builds cloud platform services powering provisioning and lifecycle management of Teradata compute infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Key focus areas include:
* Cloud native provisioning and lifecycle automation for distributed compute environments
* Platform services for orchestration, scaling, and configuration management across public cloud platforms
* Serverless and event driven automation frameworks for infrastructure workflows
* Secure and reliable connectivity enablement for cloud deployed compute systems

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop cloud native platform services for distributed infrastructure systems
* Design platform capabilities supporting large scale infrastructure provisioning
* Build scalable orchestration workflows using serverless technologies
* Develop automation for provisioning, scaling, upgrades, and teardown workflows
* Implement reliable and fault tolerant provisioning pipelines
* Build REST APIs supporting platform orchestration workflows
* Collaborate with networking and infrastructure teams
* Troubleshoot provisioning and lifecycle failures

**Qualifications**

* Strong experience working with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Strong programming experience in Python or similar languages
* Experience designing infrastructure automation using cloud APIs or IaC tools
* Experience building serverless or event driven systems
* Strong understanding of IAM, networking, multi region deployments, and cloud APIs
* Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or GitHub Actions
* Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working across multiple cloud platforms
* Experience building internal platform services used by multiple teams
* Experience working with Kubernetes or distributed infrastructure systems

**Minimum Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline with 6+ years experience
* Advanced degree with 4+ years experience

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth**

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia**
. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

**This is not an 'offshore' support role.**
Our India team is a
**core product hub**
, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

**The Role: Engineering Confidence**

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.

* **Engineer the Safety Net**
  : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left**
  : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality**
  : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity**
  : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience**
  : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Web Automation**
  : We use
  **Playwright**
  for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation**
  : We use
  **Cucumber-Scala**
  to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation**
  : We leverage
  **Maestro E2E**
  and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops**
  : We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
  **CI/CD**
  to run your tests on every commit.

**Want to look under the hood?**
Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
tech.endowus.com

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days (Immersion)**
  : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)**
  : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)**
  : You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:

**Must-Haves**
:

* **4+ Years of Test Engineering**
  : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals**
  : You are proficient in at least one major language (
  **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python**
  ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence**
  : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
  **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium**
  . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA**
  : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset**
  : You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

**Nice-to-Haves**
:

* **Mobile Automation**
  : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing**
  : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain**
  : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

**Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business**
  : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World-Class Engineering Talent**
  : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside**
  : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree**
  : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

**Why NOT Endowus?**

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer 100% Automation**
  : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure**
  : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning**
  : If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote**
  : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

**The Interview Process**

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

**About Costco Wholesale:**

Costco Wholesale is a multi-billion-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries. They provide a wide selection of quality merchandise, plus the convenience of specialty departments and exclusive member services, all designed to make shopping a pleasurable experience for their members.

**About Costco Wholesale India:**

At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members’ experiences and make employees’ jobs easier. Our employees play a key role in driving and delivering innovation to establish IT as a core competitive advantage for Costco Wholesale.

**Position: Engineer - SAP Linux**

**Position Summary:**

* Engineers have deep knowledge and hands-on experience in enterprise-wide platforms and solve technical problems while working on technology initiatives. Engineers have strong architectural, leadership, and technical skills. They ensure delivery of high-quality artifacts, and adhere to and follow Costco’s SDLC. Engineers interact in a highly effective manner with other team members and management, drive innovation, and influence delivery and performance.
* This SAP Linux Systems Engineer designs, builds, and maintains the Red Hat/Suse Linux US and International environments. The Engineer oversees planning of the integration of licensed and/or OEM software packages, as well as all strategic and tactical planning of the environment required to meet Costco-specific business needs. The Engineer filling this role will also be expected to deliver excellent customer service and to interact in a highly effective manner with other team members and management. The ideal candidate must be accomplished in areas of analysis, design, installation, implementation, configuration, tuning, operations and security of RedHat systems. Costco is looking for a creative individual who can effectively manage projects and multiple tasks to meet business objectives.

**Job Duties/Essential Functions:**

* Automates, documents, shares, educates, delegates, and improves processes.
* Builds prototypes of potential features.
* Creates conceptual and detailed technical design documents and standards.
* Enhances automation of applications, systems, and platforms and identifies opportunities for streamlining, and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborates with architects to plan, design, implement, and improve new capabilities, enhancements, solutions and/or platforms.
* Applies knowledge to practical and sustainable applications and capabilities.
* Partners with project managers, solution leads, and other stakeholders to establish the rough order of magnitude estimates, to create and maintain a robust framework to support applications, and to deliver quality solutions.
* Contributes, interprets, and communicates enterprise, technical, project, and operational strategies to the team.
* Develops team vision to drive new capabilities against a published roadmap, in conjunction with management.
* Ensures that proposed and existing systems are aligned with organizational standards, goals, and objectives.
* Formulates and directs activities that align short term goals and long-term initiatives while providing accurate and timely estimates of work breakdown schedules.
* Works with teams, management, and stakeholders to conceptualize, design, build, test, and release products.
* Shares relevant information among teams.
* Influences and drives adoption of best practices and high-quality standards throughout the division.
* Integrates diverse solution components across multiple platforms using industry standard interfaces.
* Tests and resolves problems, performs root cause analysis, identifies gaps, recommends solutions and preventative measures, and leads team members to solution delivery plans.
* Runs proof of concepts and uses diagnostic/debugging skills to solve current challenges in multi-platform systems.
* Orchestrates reviews for system additions and/or enhancements.
* Promotes and supports a culture of compliance, risk avoidance/mitigation, and corporate accountability throughout the organization through technical leadership, knowledge of business need, development and communication of policies, procedures, and plans, and assurance of solution designs that are in compliance with architecture standards, technology guardrails, security, and operational guidelines.
* Provides leadership/mentoring to team members, implements development efficiencies, creates appropriate. documentation, drives operational efficiencies and technical growth within the team, and supports the release model.
* Optimizes team efficiency and performance through high level technical direction.
* Provides technical leadership in implementation of applications, strategic planning sessions, documentation of requirements, tool implementation, database query languages, and programming languages.
* Uses subject matter expertise to support industry standard source control and source change management techniques.
* Presents technical designs and solutions to executives, management, and other audiences to gain consensus and/or project approval.
* Develops enterprise-class Red Hat solutions that support the enterprise SAP Landscape in US and International.
* Develops and enhances automated processes to minimize downtime, improve performance, and the security of the system architectures.
* Develops and designs tool sets that simplify provisioning and support on premises and on Azure.
* Acts as a senior escalation point for complex issues. Ensures timely recovery from outages, performs root cause analysis, and implements preventative measures.

**Solution Planning:**

* Works with vendors, business and application development teams, and other technical teams to meet the needs of the project.
* Works with Solution Architects and SAP Basis Engineers to develop, implement and support new capabilities and designs.
* Analyzes technical risks and advises on risk mitigation strategies.
* Works with the Solution Architects and Project Managers to develop a high-level project schedule, resource plan for the project, and project costs.

**Solution Delivery:**

* Implements and maintains enterprise class Linux solutions that support SAP systems.
* Designs and implements a toolset that simplifies provisioning and support of a large enterprise environment.
* Plans and executes major platform software and operating system upgrades and maintenance across a highly virtualized environment.
* Takes responsibility for the technical content (architecture and design), integrity and quality of solution.
* Takes accountability for the delivery of the solution as specified (by requirements and architecture).
* Analyzes available assets (frameworks, reference architectures, etc.) to bridge the gap between the as-is architecture and the to-be architecture.
* Practices adherence to IT standards.
* Collaborates and partners with SAP Application teams to create a continuous integration pipeline focused on automation.
* Collaborates and partners with SAP Application and Database administrators to standardize and automate deployments.
* Plans and executes major platform software and operating system upgrades and maintenance across a highly virtualized environment.
* Collaborates with SAP Release Management team, manages the planning, implementation, and upgrade of OEM packages.
* Manages system resources to assure maximum system performance and appropriate additional capacity for peak periods and growth.
* Plans, configures, and implements features on the Red Hat platforms that improve availability, response time, and monitoring of key system metrics.
* Collaborates with the Enterprise Linux team to design and review decision documents.
* Manages daily activities of configuration and operation of SAP IT systems.
* Provides in-depth experience in troubleshooting SAP IT systems.
* Takes part of the on-call support rotation and provides support to the user community using incident and problem management tools, email, and voicemail.
* Maintain automated processes and workflows.
* Performs root cause analysis on Incidents and Problems.
* Regular and reliable workplace attendance at your assigned location.

**Required:**

* Advanced knowledge of Linux system administration.
* Excellent knowledge of Linux methods.
* IT experience and Red Hat Linux experience in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with a diverse range of orchestration suites and tools, including, but not limited to: Puppet Enterprise, HP Operations Orchestration, GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, Ansible.
* Demonstrated ability with programming and scripting languages including, but not limited to, Python, Powershell, and shell scripting.
* Experienced in working closely with development teams to define and optimize CI/CD pipeline processes.
* Proven ability to perform custom RPM builds.
* Strong Cloud experience in Azure.
* Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or SUSE certification or higher certification or equivalent engineering experience.
* Experience with Satellite, preferably 6.0 and newer.
* Experience developing and documenting standard operating procedures and best practices in a technical repository.
* Demonstrated ability in Systems Management and Administration (applying fixes, loading the OS, creating Gold images, resolving system issues, working with suppliers to resolve issues, etc).
* Strong scripting language expertise.
* Strong focus on design, build, deployment, security, system hardening, and securing services.
* Controls consistency and integrity monitoring and health checks of the operating system structure.
* Proven expertise in Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning.
* Understanding of Configuration Management and Change Management Best Practices.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills and the ability to logically think through problem situations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to partner with others in the area or company to deliver quality solutions.
* Able to work effectively and produce consistent results with minimum supervision. Self-motivated, responsible, conscientious, and detail-oriented.
* Able to work well under pressure and handle crisis situations professionally.
* Strong experience with services in Enterprise – Active Directory, DNS, Apache, Tomcat.
* Strong understanding of Kerberos, cross-realm authentication, and Kerberized services.
* Proven experience reviewing and comparing multiple platform options for a given application and collaborating with appropriate teams to choose the right platform.
* Available for periodic off-hours work, including weekends and holidays and be able to provide 24x7 on-call support as necessary.

**Recommended:**

* BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent formal training and experience.
* 8+ years’ IT experience and 6+ years’ Red Hat Linux experience in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with VMWare and virtualized environments.
* Working knowledge of Python, Puppet, and Ansible scripting language.
* Successful internal candidates will have spent one year or more on their current team.

**Other Conditions:**

* Management will review the Job Analysis for this position prior to a job offer.

title: Associate Director - AI Infrastructure Architect (AI Factory)
description:
**Summary**
Novartis architecture principles call for AI adoption guided by business value: AI is evaluated for new solutions and enhancements wherever it delivers a clear benefit, and it must be delivered on infrastructure that is secure, compliant and economically sustainable. Within Cloud & Hosting Services, AI & HPC Engineering is the single product management and delivery channel for AI infrastructure and AI use-case onboarding. The AI Infrastructure Architect sets the architecture those platforms are built to.
  
  
The role defines the reference architecture and guardrails for AI workloads across Azure, AWS and private AI environments: training and inference platforms, GPU capacity and scheduling, data pipelines and data access, model operations, logging, monitoring, cost control and lifecycle governance. It establishes the standard intake pattern by which an AI use case moves from idea to a hosted, monitored, auditable service, so that scientists and business teams get speed without the organisation inheriting uncontrolled risk.
  
  
This is an individual contributor architecture role. Its authority comes from design quality, evidence and adoption rather than from line management.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the AI infrastructure reference architecture and the standards that govern training, fine-tuning, inference and retrieval-augmented patterns across public cloud and private AI hosting.
* Define the standard AI workload intake pattern, including architecture review criteria, data classification handling, environment selection and the conditions under which a use case may go to production.
* Set guardrails for sensitive data, model access, prompt and inference logging, monitoring, resilience, retention and cost, in partnership with Security, Data Privacy and Quality.
* Design GPU and accelerator capacity patterns - shared pools, reservations, scheduling, quotas and burst to cloud - and support the associated capacity and cost models.
* Support qualification of AI platforms, regions and services for enterprise consumption together with AI & HPC Engineering and the public cloud architects.
* Define the MLOps and LLMOps reference chain: model registry, versioning, evaluation, deployment, drift and performance monitoring, and decommissioning.
* Maintain architecture decision records for AI platform choices, linking each to business value, risk posture and total cost of ownership.
* Advise business, research and Infrastructure Solution Delivery stakeholders on feasible AI infrastructure options, and translate scientific and commercial requirements into technical designs.
* Track the AI infrastructure market, evaluate emerging accelerators, model-serving stacks and platform services, and bring credible innovation into the roadmap.
* Coach engineers and architects on AI infrastructure practice and act as a role model for the Novartis Values and Behaviours.

**Essential Requirement**

* 8+ years' experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform architecture, with a strong track record of designing and supporting enterprise-scale technology solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in building, deploying, and operating AI and machine learning infrastructure within production environments.
* Experience enabling AI solutions to transition from proof-of-concept stages into scalable, governed, and business-critical services.
* Strong knowledge of GPU and accelerator technologies, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-based AI platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Hands-on experience with model serving, inference optimization, MLOps/LLMOps practices, and modern data and vector pipeline architectures.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, observability, cost optimization (FinOps), and secure AI platform operations.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, including explainability, auditability, logging, human oversight, and risk management controls.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI infrastructure concepts to technical and non-technical audiences while driving collaboration across engineering, security, privacy, and business teams.

**Desirable Requirement**

* Fluent English, written and spoken. Additional languages are an asset.

**You’ll receive:**
You can find everything you need to know about our benefits and rewards in the Novartis Life Handbook. https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits-rewards
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams' representative of the patients and communities we serve.
  
  
**Join our Novartis Network**
: If this role is not suitable to your experience or career goals but you wish to stay connected to hear more about Novartis and our career opportunities, join the Novartis Network here:
  
  
https://talentnetwork.novartis.com/network
  
  
**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

title: DataOps Engineer IV
description:

  **AWS**

title: Senior CAD Engineer
description:

Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
We are now looking for a Physical Design Methodology and Operations Engineer! You'll join a small team that owns the infrastructure powering NVIDIA's semiconductor design flows — coordinating hundreds of thousands of jobs per day across datacenters with 10,000+ hosts, serving over 1,000 chip designers worldwide. Our platform spans job orchestration, event-driven trigger systems, global service interconnection, web interfaces to tools, and a Jenkins-like CI/CD backbone — a production system with direct stakes in GPU, CPU, SoC and networking tapeouts. You'll own a functional area within the team while contributing across broader operations. Our stack includes mature Perl and Python services alongside modern React frontends and Elasticsearch-based telemetry. We're actively modernizing, and we need someone who can think architecturally — evaluating what we have, identifying what needs to change, and driving that evolution in a way the team can execute and maintain. If you want to own something critical at scale and shape how it grows, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing and supporting mechanisms for coordinating and maintaining large-scale semiconductor design tasks across multiple global datacenters.
* Owning the architecture of one or more platform components — defining interfaces, data models, and service boundaries that can scale and evolve.

* Debugging and improving production services spanning web browsers, containerized microservices, and bare-metal Linux hosts.
* Building and improving web interfaces to configure, launch, and analyze EDA tools and design flows.
* Mining and analyzing large datasets of job execution telemetry and tool quality-of-results data to improve flows and catch regressions.
* Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to design reviews and technical standards across the team.
* Helping invent next-generation semiconductor design methodology.
* Optionally, contributing directly to the physical design of GPU, CPU, SoC, and networking products — a rare opportunity for an infrastructure engineer.

**What We Want To See**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or computer systems engineering (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of designing and delivering production systems.
* Strong software architecture and design skills — experience defining service boundaries, APIs, data models, and system interfaces.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Perl; comfort with JavaScript and web technologies.
* Experience with distributed systems at meaningful scale.
* Proven ability to lead a project through its full lifecycle, from requirement solicitation to architecture design, to implementation, to maintenance and support.

* Experience with workflow orchestration systems (Airflow, Argo, Temporal, Luigi, or similar).
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana / Vega for telemetry and dashboarding.
* Experience with MSSQL/Mysql/SQLite or other relational and NoSQL datastores.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us. If you're an engineer who thinks in systems, takes pride in designing things that last, and wants to see the silicon your work helps produce — we want to hear from you.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
description:
**Description**
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.
  
  
This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.
* Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.
* Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.
* Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.
* Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.
* Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**
We're looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to own the design, resilience, and day-to-day health of HealthEdge's infrastructure across AWS and our hybrid on-prem/Azure/GCP estate. This role sits at the intersection of cloud engineering and infrastructure engineering spanning AWS migration execution, disaster recovery, patching and platform currency, and the security/compliance controls that keep our security obligations intact. It's a hands-on senior IC role for someone who wants deep ownership of infrastructure resilience across a large, multi-account, multi-platform environment that's actively migrating off legacy on-prem infrastructure.
  
  
**Areas of Responsibility:**
**Infrastructure and Hybrid Cloud Architecture**

* Own infrastructure across the environments including secure configuration baselines and patch management for OS images and on-prem hardware
* Design, build, and maintain infrastructure across AWS (primary), with supporting work in Azure and GCP, plus the on-prem estate still in active retirement
* Build and maintain reusable, auditable Infrastructure as Code for cloud deployments, and for remaining on-prem server deployment.
* Support cloud networking execution, VPC provisioning, security group standards, and related connectivity work.
* Manage storage across cloud and legacy on-prem storage as workloads migrate; contribute to on-prem retirement and datacenter decommissioning efforts.
* Support AWS migration execution for in-flight waves, including server deployments and resource change requests via IaC.

**Disaster Recovery & Resilience**

* Own disaster recovery architecture and execution across cloud environments.
* Maintain DR solutions and backup strategy and run DR drills on a regular cadence; document gaps and drive remediation.
* Design for resilience from the start and treat recoverability as a first-class requirement, not an afterthought.

**Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management**

* Contribute to vulnerability management triage across infrastructure teams, threat detection, and infra security findings review.
* Support PHI/PII classification scanning, penetration test coordination, and security exception approvals.
* Maintain compliance controls; support HIPAA and SOC 2 audit readiness, access review and recertification, evidence collection, and change freeze coordination.
* Maintain EKS container runtime security sensor coverage as part of ongoing platform hardening.

**Cloud Infrastructure Operations**

* Design and manage roles and cross-account access controls following least-privilege principles across multi-account, multi-cloud environments.
* Own cloud execution: load balancers, DNS (), VPC provisioning, and security group standards.
* Manage compute resources at scale with an eye toward right-sizing and long-term maintainability.
* Administer cloud storage and database services with attention to cost, performance, and resilience.
* Own infrastructure health, cost, and performance monitoring using native and third-party tooling, building the observability that lets issues surface before they become incidents.
* Administer and harden Linux and Windows Server environments across cloud and on-prem, including patching, performance tuning, troubleshooting, Active Directory integration, Group Policy, DNS, and certificate services.
* Manage hybrid identity and authentication across on-prem and cloud workloads, and maintain OS-level security baselines and hardening standards across the estate.

**CI/CD, Automation & Delivery**

* Build and evolve CI/CD pipelines for secure, repeatable infrastructure deployments.
* Write automation to reduce manual toil and enforce operational consistency across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Take solutions from proof-of-concept to production with an eye toward long-term maintainability, not just getting it working once.

**Reliability, Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor, scale, and maintain production infrastructure with availability, performance, and security as top priorities.
* Participate in on-call rotation; serve as L2 escalation point for cross-team infrastructure support; lead root cause analysis and drive incident retrospectives to closure.
* Author and maintain runbooks that hold up under pressure, not just at handoff.

**Cost & Tagging Governance**

* Contribute to FinOps efforts: identify and remediate cost anomalies, own tagging remediation against enterprise tagging standards, and make pragmatic cost/performance/resilience tradeoffs.

**AI-Enabled Engineering**

* Use AI coding assistants to accelerate IaC development, scripting, and troubleshooting.
* Use AI tooling to draft first-pass runbooks, DR documentation, and incident retrospectives to validate and refine before publishing.

**Collaboration & Documentation**

* Document architecture, DR runbooks, and standard operating procedures others can actually follow under pressure.
* Provide technical guidance to product teams on infrastructure resilience, migration sequencing, and recovery design.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise in AWS and in other cloud environments.
* Direct experience with disaster recovery design and execution.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
* Experience with containerized environments and Kubernetes/EKS, including version upgrade and lifecycle management.
* Linux and Windows Server administration experience, including patching and OS lifecycle management at scale.
* Solid IAM design experience, including cross-account access and least-privilege enforcement.
* Strong scripting ability (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfortable being the primary on-call and L2 escalation point for infrastructure incidents.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating in regulated environments (FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2) and understanding of what that means for infrastructure and DR design specifically.
* AWS certification (Solutions Architect or SysOps, Associate or Professional).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure, bridging on-prem virtualization with cloud-native services during active migration.
* Familiarity with DISA STIG or CIS benchmark hardening, and vulnerability management/triage workflows.
* FinOps or cost governance experience, including tagging standards enforcement.
* Healthcare technology or digital health platform background.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows as part of daily practice.

**Behaviors & Traits**

* Raises risk early rather than waiting for it to become an incident.
* Comfortable with ambiguity in a large, multi-account, evolving cloud environment.
* Strong sense of ownership; closes gaps rather than escalating and waiting.
* Communicates technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Engineering Manager Cloud
description:
We are looking for a technically strong
**Engineering Manager**
who can lead by example — someone who can architect, build, and ship modern cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure while mentoring and growing a high-performing engineering team. This is a
**coding manager role**
: you’ll be contributing code, reviewing PRs (Pull Requests), and helping define best practices alongside your team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead a team of software/cloud engineers building Azure-native applications.

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of cloud engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.
* Provide strategic direction and technical leadership on cloud-based solutions.
* Manage resource allocation, timelines, and project priorities, ensuring the successful execution of cloud engineering projects.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and team-building activities.

* Design and develop scalable cloud-native applications using Azure services (e.g., App Services, Azure Functions , Cosmos DB, AKS).

* Support implementation of cloud automation, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform, ARM templates, or Azure DevOps.
* Adherence and improvisation of Agile development methodologies across development and QA process.

1. **Cloud Infrastructure Management:**

* Oversee the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and security services.
* Ensure the environment meets high standards for uptime, performance, and security.
* Design and manage cloud networking architectures, including virtual networks, subnets, VPNs, and Firewall.

1. **Collaboration & Cross-functional Coordination:**

* Work with development teams to integrate cloud services into applications and workflows.
* Collaborate with IT, QA, Product, Operations, and other teams to implement security controls, monitoring, and compliance.
* Lead and support continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for cloud applications and services.

1. **Process Improvement & Best Practices:**

* Stay updated on the latest Azure features, tools, and industry trends to continuously evolve the engineering team’s capabilities.

* Manage and optimize cloud costs, leveraging Azure Cost Management tools and cost optimization strategies.

* Expertise in Azure services, such as Azure Compute, Storage, Networking, Security, and Identity Management.

* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence and motivate technical teams.

5–8 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced OpenShift Engineer to deploy, configure, operate, and support application stacks on Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes platforms. The role requires strong hands-on experience in containerized application deployment, CI/CD enablement, release automation, troubleshooting, and production support in enterprise environments.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in OpenShift, Kubernetes, DevOps, release engineering, or application deployment support.

* Good understanding of OpenShift resources including projects/namespaces, pods, deployments, services, routes, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVCs, and RBAC.

* Experience in Linux administration, shell scripting, networking basics, DNS, certificates, and application connectivity troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze logs, events, pipeline output, pod status, resource limits, and application errors to resolve deployment issues.
* Strong communication, documentation, coordination, and problem-solving skills in a multi-team delivery environment.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, or hybrid cloud infrastructure environments.
* Knowledge of Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, OpenShift GitOps, or OpenShift Pipelines.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code or automation tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
* Exposure to monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or OpenShift monitoring stack.
* Awareness of container security practices, image scanning, secrets management, RBAC, and security context constraints.

**Working Expectations**

* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear documentation for design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.

description:

DevOps best practices and the Azure cloud ecosystem for AI enabled software solutions. You will be part of a scrum team working closely with Product Owner and business stakeholders. The Lead Software Engineer takes ownership of key engineering projects, provides technical guidance to junior engineers, and ensures that software is delivered on time and within scope. This position requires strong problem-solving skills, expertise in software engineering practices, and the ability to work in a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Daily tasks are for example:

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above.
  
  

* 7+ years of hands-on experience with DevOps.
* Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, industry best practices and tooling
* Sound understanding of Azure cloud services, infrastructure, pipelines, scalability and architecture
* Experience deploying solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure Foundry, model versioning & quota mgmt.
* Experience with RAG pipelines (Azure AI Search, embedding pipelines, indexing jobs)
* Exposure to Agentic frameworks (MAF, MCP/A2A plugins, etc)
* Observability design (App Insights/Azure Monitor, OpenTelemetry) and incident response
* Good understanding of Managed Identity first, Key Vault integration, secure network boundaries, Azure Policy, RBAC, networking, private endpoints
* Solid experience of Azure Bicep, PowerShell scripts and Yaml for IaC.
* Understanding of data governance (PII, tenant isolation) for AI workloads

As a person, you have the following traits:
  
  

* Taking ownership. Comfortable taking the lead on tasks.
* Earn trust, think big, and take calculated risks.
* You collaborate with team members to work towards common goals.
* Solid problem-solving skills and comfortable questioning assumptions and as-is.
* Exhibits a consistent approach and a creative mindset.
* Thrives in a collaborative environment and values teamwork
* Like to have fun at work and positivity comes easily to you
* Excellent English verbal and communication skills

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

title: GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer to build, configure, deploy, and maintain GPU-enabled infrastructure for AI/ML and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with GPU server setup, on-premises AI infrastructure, Linux administration, NVIDIA GPU drivers, CUDA, containerization, infrastructure automation, and GPU workload deployment.

Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM), GPU cluster bring-up, InfiniBand networking, and LLM application deployment will be highly preferred. Candidates with experience across different GPU hardware vendors and cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments are welcome.

Key Responsibilities

* Set up, configure, and maintain GPU-enabled servers, compute nodes, and AI infrastructure.
* Build and deploy on-premises AI infrastructure and GPU compute clusters.
* Perform end-to-end GPU cluster bring-up, including provisioning, configuration, validation, and testing.
* Configure and manage NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) for cluster deployment and management, where applicable.
* Install and configure operating systems, GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, libraries, and supporting software.
* Deploy and maintain GPU workloads on bare-metal servers, cloud platforms, and hybrid environments.
* Configure GPU-enabled Docker containers and Kubernetes workloads.
* Deploy and manage LLM applications using frameworks such as vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face Text Generation Inference (TGI), or NVIDIA Triton.
* Configure and troubleshoot GPU hardware, driver compatibility, CUDA initialization, memory utilization, and workload execution issues.
* Support InfiniBand networking and high-speed interconnects for multi-GPU or multi-node environments.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment using appropriate scripting and automation tools.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
* Monitor GPU utilization, memory, temperature, power consumption, system health, and performance.
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, health checks, and automated recovery using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Optimize GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, inference latency, throughput, and overall infrastructure performance.
* Troubleshoot Linux, networking, storage, container, hardware, and application deployment issues.
* Perform infrastructure upgrades, patching, maintenance, capacity planning, and resource scaling.
* Maintain technical documentation, installation procedures, configuration guides, and troubleshooting records.
* Collaborate with AI/ML, development, platform, and infrastructure teams to support production workloads.

Required Technical Skills

**GPU Infrastructure and Hardware**

* Hands-on experience with GPU server setup, configuration, and operations.
* Knowledge of GPU hardware, server components, PCIe, power requirements, cooling, and hardware compatibility.
* Experience with GPU models such as NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, L40S, RTX series, or equivalent GPU platforms.

**Linux, Drivers, and CUDA**

* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience installing and configuring GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, and supporting libraries.
* Ability to validate GPU detection, driver functionality, CUDA compatibility, and workload execution.

**AI Infrastructure and HPC**

* Experience building or maintaining on-premises AI infrastructure.
* Understanding of GPU cluster provisioning, compute nodes, and cluster validation.
* Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) is preferred.
* Experience deploying on-premises GPU infrastructure without BCM is also valuable.
* Knowledge of InfiniBand, RDMA, and high-speed networking for GPU clusters is an advantage.

**DevOps and Containerization**

* Experience with Docker and GPU-enabled containers.
* Kubernetes experience for GPU workload deployment and orchestration.
* Infrastructure automation using Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, configuration management, and infrastructure monitoring.

**LLM Deployment and Performance**

* Experience deploying LLM applications on GPU-enabled cloud instances or on-premises GPU servers.
* Familiarity with vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face TGI, NVIDIA Triton, or equivalent model-serving frameworks.
* Understanding of API-based model serving and GPU resource allocation.
* Experience troubleshooting GPU memory issues and optimizing inference performance.
* Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA SMI, or DCGM for GPU monitoring.

Experience Requirements

* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering.
* At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience working with GPU environments.
* Demonstrated experience in at least one real-world GPU infrastructure or AI deployment project.
* Ability to explain the infrastructure architecture, GPU hardware used, individual responsibilities, deployment process, and technical issues resolved.
* Experience supporting production environments is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* End-to-end GPU cluster deployment using NVIDIA BCM.
* Hands-on InfiniBand configuration and troubleshooting.
* Bare-metal GPU server installation and configuration without Docker.
* Multi-GPU or multi-node cluster deployment.
* Production LLM serving and GPU performance optimization.
* Experience across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for engineers with practical infrastructure experience who can independently configure GPU environments, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and support reliable AI/ML and HPC deployments.

Candidates must be able to explain real projects they have worked on, the GPU hardware and tools used, their individual contributions, and the challenges they successfully resolved.

description:

**AI Engineers, Data Specialists, Architects, Cloud Engineers, and technology innovators**
who want to solve complex challenges, build solutions from the ground up, and shape what comes next.

AI Platform Owner (MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps Lead)

Ful Time/ Permanent

**Experience –**
12+ years in cloud platform / DevOps engineering, of which 3+ years on Azure and 2+ years running MLOps / LLMOps or AI platform services

**Work Location –**
Hyderabad

**Purpose of the role**

Own the shared Azure Data & AI platform and its MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps lifecycle as an ArcelorMittal product: service catalogue, environments, registries, pipelines, evaluation gates, monitoring, cost and rollback patterns that every Solution Pod consumes. ArcelorMittal names a platform owner who accepts the transferred capabilities and takes ownership after a joint readiness review. MLOps, LLMOps and AgentOps refer to the operational lifecycle practices for models, large-language-model applications and agents.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Co-own and then own the target Azure Data & AI platform architecture, service catalogue and platform backlog.
* Define the MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps lifecycle: environments, registries (AI registry and agent inventory), pipelines, evaluation gates, promotion, versioning, monitoring and rollback patterns.
* Establish cost management, performance, reliability and observability standards; own platform telemetry dashboards and cloud cost controls.
* Provide self-service paths and golden templates (infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, agent runtime, grounding, content safety) for pod engineering.
* Review platform changes and operational readiness with DevOps engineers, Security and ArcelorMittal operations; run the joint readiness review that precedes ownership transfer.
* Lead the ArcelorMittal AI Platform team (Platform Engineers, Data & AI Platform Engineers) and accept transferred services, runbooks and documentation.
* Manage platform dependencies on ArcelorMittal cloud (landing zone, networking, identity), Aura/Databricks and licences/quotas.
* Operate the platform ArcelorMittal-led with partner advisory support; define the long-term operations and support model.

**Preferred Skills**

The successful AI Platform Owner (MLOps / LLMOps / AgentOps Lead) combines strong professional depth with a practical delivery mindset. The individual must be able to establish clear methods, make sound decisions, develop colleagues and progressively assume ownership from the implementation partner. Success requires confidence working across India and Europe and balanced judgement across delivery speed, reuse, security and Responsible AI.

* Azure platform engineering: landing zones, Azure Policy, infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/Terraform), Azure DevOps / GitHub CI/CD, networking and identity
* MLOps / LLMOps practices: model and prompt versioning, evaluation gates, Azure AI Foundry deployments, monitoring and drift detection, rollback
* Operating AI services: Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Content Safety, Container Apps / Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure API Management
* Platform product ownership: service catalogue, backlog management, service-level agreements, cloud cost management
* Operational readiness: runbooks, incident management, observability (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics)
* Microsoft Fabric and Databricks platform administration
* Policy-as-code, DevSecOps and GitHub Advanced Security
* Experience leading offshore/nearshore engineering teams (India Global Capability Centre)
* Certifications: AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), AZ-305, AI-102, Terraform Associate

**Good to have skills**

* Stakeholder orientation
* Results orientation
* Courage to challenge
* Inspire trust
* Innovation and learning agility
* Decision making
* Cross-cultural collaboration
* Capability building and knowledge transfer

**Qualifications**

Bachelor degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data, Business or a relevant discipline. Advanced degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage.

**Deliverables**

This role helps establish a permanent ArcelorMittal AI capability, embeds repeatable engineering and control practices, and reduces dependency on the implementation partner through structured ownership transfer. Success is demonstrated when:

* Pods use supported platform paths; releases are reproducible and rollback is proven; evaluation and telemetry are present for every agent; platform documentation, service catalogue, monitoring and security controls are complete and a joint readiness review is accepted before ownership transfer; platform support burden is controlled.
* AI platform architecture and service catalogue; MLOps/LLMOps lifecycle standard; evaluation and release gates; golden templates; monitoring and rollback patterns; platform roadmap; operational handover acceptance record.

**Time Zone**

India Standard Time (IST) with European working hours (CET/GMT) overlap
